title: Sept 11 Surrender and Custody Timeline
description: Timestamp-by-timestamp map of Tyler Robinson's September 11, 2025 surrender, Miranda timing, Discord messages, and custody-chain disputes.
why_interesting: Bates 003996-R2 bodycam reportedly shows Robinson Mirandized at 6:25 PM — about two hours BEFORE the 8:02 PM call that supposedly first identified him, and before his ~7:57 PM Discord "confession" messages.

title: Site Changes and Crime-Scene Handling After the UVU Event
description: Claims that the UVU tent area where Charlie Kirk was struck was torn up and paved within days, destroying trace evidence.
why_interesting: Registry threads claim Hardscape Specialties LLC was dormant ~20 years and revived February 2025, months before the shooting; a work order reportedly issued two days after, no public bidding, finish-by-Monday.

title: Media Narratives and Censorship Concerns After the UVU Event
description: How mainstream and citizen narratives diverged after Sept 10, plus allegations that footage, accounts, and records were deleted or suppressed.
why_interesting: Witness Ryne Simmons says he recorded 4K/60fps UVU footage, sent it to the FBI, and was asked to delete it — a request he says he refused; officials have neither confirmed nor denied it.

title: Legal Process, Gag Orders, and Hearing Secrecy
description: Gag orders, closed hearings, sealed ATF ballistics, and discovery fights in State v. Tyler Robinson, case 251403576.
why_interesting: Reporting cited here says the ATF comparison of the autopsy bullet jacket to the Mauser 98 came back INCONCLUSIVE — and the defense moved in March 2026 to seal that report, opposed by a press coalition.

title: Institutional Resignations After the Shooting
description: Leadership departures after September 10, 2025 — sheriff, UVU president, judges, FBI SAC, hospital CEO — and the timing questions raised.
why_interesting: Former NCTC director Joe Kent has said the foreign-nexus review was halted around October 28, 2025 before its leads were exhausted; the sheriff and UVU's president both resigned in 2026.

title: After Events
description: Hub for everything after 12:23 PM Sept 10, 2025, including the W 925 S block thread and the Israel-region Google Trends claim.
why_interesting: A Google Trends chart for "645 W 925 S" filtered to the region Israel is reportedly flat for five years except one spike to 100 in April 2022 — for a house on the same Orem block.

title: The House at 691 W 925 S, Orem (Alleged Staging Site)
description: Hub page for the citizen allegation that the attack was planned or staged from a house just north of the UVU campus.
why_interesting: The house at the center of the staging allegation is owned outright by Utah Valley University itself — the very institution hosting the event — not by a private family.

title: West 925 South Block — Neighbors, Ring Video & Court Record
description: Maps the 600–700 block of West 925 South: court-admitted Ring video, the Palantir rumor, and the UVU-owned house.
why_interesting: Court-admitted Ring/Nest video from 680 W 925 S reportedly shows a grey Dodge Challenger parking across the street at 00:30:08 on Sept 11 — the same block as the alleged staging house.

title: The RETCON13 5G Comms Mast at the UVU Construction Site
description: An unverified citizen claim that the mast at the UVU construction site on Sept 10 is a police/military tactical communications antenna.
why_interesting: A citizen investigator claims the telescoping mast standing at the UVU construction site on the day of the assassination matches the RETCON13 5G antenna sold for police and military special-operations vehicles.

title: The Staging Allegation — 691 W 925 S
description: States the staging claim verbatim, marks it unverified, and lists exactly what would confirm or kill it.
why_interesting: The entire allegation is a single unsourced line in the master investigation file — no date, no evidence, no chain of custody — yet the address sits a quarter-mile from the shooting site.

title: 691 W 925 S — Ownership on Record
description: Board and county records showing Utah Valley University purchased the house in 2019 for $900,000 from the Theobald family.
why_interesting: UVU's own board called the house "contiguous to campus" and paid $900,000 — above the $755,000 assessed value — saying it could be used for "hosting events or housing campus visitors."

title: 691 W 925 S — Neighborhood, Cameras & Witness Reports
description: The ATF/police door-to-door Ring canvass, the homeowner whose camera caught the suspect, and three separate grey Challenger claims.
why_interesting: Three different grey Dodge Challenger sightings get merged in commentary — an 8:29 a.m. campus arrival, court-admitted 00:30 Ring video at 680 W, and an unproduced citizen clip at the alleged staging house.

title: 691 W 925 S — Citizen Investigation Coverage
description: Log of citizen posts and videos alleging the Orem house was a command center, with the skeptical replies recorded alongside.
why_interesting: A widely shared walkthrough claims box trucks and a dumpster formed a barricade at the property the morning of 9/10, and that the site has a clear line of sight to the Losee Center roof.

title: 691 W 925 S — Records You Can Request (GRAMA)
description: Ready-to-file Utah GRAMA request templates that would confirm or kill the staging lead, with addresses and deadlines.
why_interesting: Because the alleged staging house is owned by a public university, its lease, key-issuance, and occupancy records for September 2025 are legally requestable by any citizen within 10 business days.

title: Visa Revocations After Online Celebrations
description: Documented pattern of visa revocations, deportations, and firings targeting people who celebrated Charlie Kirk's death online.
why_interesting: Reuters reportedly counted 600-plus workplace actions over Kirk-related posts, alongside State Department visa revocations — an enforcement wave with little public record of its criteria.

title: After Investigation Index
description: Routing index of every post-shooting thread with condensed timelines for the first evening, the custody chain, and the trial arc.
why_interesting: Lead investigator Hull reportedly testified at the preliminary hearing that he was never consulted about paving over the courtyard where Charlie Kirk was struck.

title: 691 W 925 S — Full Deed Chain
description: Every recorded title instrument for the parcel, from the Broderick era through the May 24, 2019 warranty deed to UVU.
why_interesting: Earlier investigators were reading an obsolete parcel serial (36:214:0001, dead since 1993); the live serial 36:443:0006 names Utah Valley University as owner of record with a campus mailing address.

title: 691 W 925 S — Location and the Property Itself
description: Physical facts about the alleged staging house and its true distance from the UVU campus.
why_interesting: The house is about a quarter-mile from campus, not the three miles aggregators imply — UVU's board itself called the 7,486 sq ft, six-bedroom property "contiguous to campus."

title: 691 W 925 S — Rental and Listing History
description: Whether the house ever appeared as a rental or short-term listing — the most testable part of the staging claim.
why_interesting: No Airbnb, Vrbo, KSL, or Apartments.com listing was found for the address, but expired short-term listings are routinely deleted, so absence proves nothing either way.

title: 691 W 925 S — Prior Owners and Connected People
description: The Broderick, Markides, and Theobald owners behind the deed chain, with alive/deceased status and public-records sourcing.
why_interesting: A construction firm was registered at the house's address in 1991, and one early owner died days after the property closed to UVU in May 2019 — recorded as coincidence, with no case connection found.

title: 691 W 925 S — Tax History and Assessed Values
description: Utah County assessed values and tax payments for the parcel, used as an occupancy detector before and after UVU bought it.
why_interesting: The county market value sat at $755,000 in 2019 while UVU paid $900,000, and the tax roll goes quiet after the university takes title — the property stops behaving like a private home.

title: 691 W 925 S — Web Search Log
description: An open notebook of the exact web queries run on the address, the useful hits, and the dead ends, so research is reproducible.
why_interesting: The single query that broke the case for this section surfaced a Utah Board of Regents agenda revealing UVU had quietly bought the alleged staging house for $900,000 in 2019.

title: September 9: The Candace Invitation
description: Charlie Kirk reportedly texted on September 9, 2025 that he would invite Candace Owens to speak at AmFest.
why_interesting: One day before he was killed, Kirk reportedly texted that he would bring Candace Owens back to AmFest; Owens says three separate sources told her Kirk feared 'they' would kill him.

title: The Fight Over Tucker's Invitation
description: Allegation that Kirk was pressed at an August 2025 donor weekend to rescind Tucker Carlson's AmFest invitation, and refused.
why_interesting: Grayzone reporting, citing five sources, says a Bridgehampton donor weekend 'went off the rails'; an attendee described Kirk afterward as 'hammered,' 'horrified,' and worried about 'blackmail.'

title: Donor Pressure on the Lineup
description: How alleged donor pressure and publicized private texts shaped who Kirk was allowed to book at AmFest.
why_interesting: Texts publicized by Candace Owens attribute to Kirk, roughly 48 hours before September 10, that he lost a major donor for refusing to cancel Carlson and was left 'no choice but to leave the pro-Israel cause.'

title: "Go Max": Kirk's Instruction to Tucker
description: Kirk's reported backstage instruction telling Tucker Carlson to 'go max' before his July 2025 TPUSA stage appearance.
why_interesting: Megyn Kelly says she captured Kirk backstage telling Carlson 'Go max…' — amplified as Kirk wanting Carlson to hit hard on Epstein and Israel, reaching roughly 962,000 views on one post.

title: The July 20, 2025 AmFest Week
description: Why the week of July 20, 2025 is treated as the anchor date of the case, including an alleged military-intelligence meeting.
why_interesting: July 20, 2025 is exactly two months before September 10, and researchers allege a military/intelligence meeting that date — the same week that carries the first Timpanogos emergency-surgeon search spikes.

title: AmFest 2024: Tucker on Epstein
description: AmericaFest 2024, where Tucker Carlson closed the first night reportedly discussing Epstein and foreign intelligence blackmail.
why_interesting: Nine months before Kirk died, his own main stage hosted Carlson reportedly describing Jeffrey Epstein's alleged role in a blackmail operation possibly run for foreign intelligence services.

title: July 2025 Summit: Smith vs Hammer
description: TPUSA's July 2025 Tampa Student Action Summit, where a staged debate covered Israel, Epstein, and Mossad.
why_interesting: Kirk personally approved a July 13, 2025 main-stage debate on the United States, Israel, Epstein and Mossad; a podcast titled 'Inside the Turning Point USA Fallout' dropped three days later.

title: The "Prove Me Wrong" Tent Replica
description: TPUSA reportedly rebuilt a replica of the debate tent from the UVU shooting at AmericaFest 2025.
why_interesting: Attendees reportedly lined up for selfies at a re-staged replica of the tent Kirk was killed under; critics called it trauma reenactment and jokes noted the replica was 'missing the camera.'

title: The August 25, 2025 AmFest Flyer
description: The December AmericaFest promotional flyer released sixteen days before Kirk was killed, and how its layout is read.
why_interesting: Released sixteen days before his death, the flyer placed Carlson prominently beside Kirk, rotated to face him — read as Kirk publicly refusing the alleged demand to drop Carlson.

title: MTG, AIPAC, and the AmFest Invite Claim
description: Circulating claims that Kirk invited Marjorie Taylor Greene to debate AIPAC at AmFest shortly before his death.
why_interesting: Viral posts claim Kirk invited Greene to AmFest on AIPAC after she demanded AIPAC register under FARA — then allege a post-death AIPAC meeting about screening 'isolationist' Republicans.

title: Murder Motive and AmFest on X
description: Archive of X discourse tying Kirk's murder to AmFest lineup fights, AIPAC, and donor pressure, with attribution.
why_interesting: Catalogs the competing motive theories circulating on X, including the claim that Kirk planned to convert TPUSA from pro-Israel to an 'anti-Zionist America Only' organization before he was killed.

title: Year-by-Year AmFest Timeline
description: Chronology of every AmericaFest and TPUSA summit the investigation touches, from 2023 through the 2026 succession disputes.
why_interesting: Buried in the 2024 entries: Google Trends screenshots reportedly show a one-week search spike in December 2024 for Kathryn Nester — who would later become Tyler Robinson's court-appointed defense attorney.

title: Candace Owens: AmFest Block Pressure
description: Claims that pro-Israel donors and influencers wanted Candace Owens kept off TPUSA's flagship stage.
why_interesting: Grades each claim: the September 9 invite text is a claimed private message, while the absence of any formal AmFest 2025 invitation to Owens after Kirk's death is itself treated as a data point.

title: Bannon at AmFest: Israel First Contention
description: Steve Bannon's AmFest remarks naming 'Greater Israel' and 'Israel First' as the movement's central fight.
why_interesting: Bannon reportedly said on the AmFest stage that Kirk worked with people around the Vice President to head off a land war or decapitation path on Iran, described in his telling as Netanyahu's plan.

title: Shapiro Names Carlson and Kelly
description: Ben Shapiro's AmericaFest 2025 remarks attacking Carlson and Kelly for not denouncing Candace Owens's theories.
why_interesting: On the first AmFest without Kirk, Shapiro reportedly called silence about Owens's theories 'cowardice' — a day after Kirk had reportedly criticized Israel to Shapiro's face on his own show.

title: Tucker's AIPAC Remarks on Stage
description: Carlson's AmericaFest 2025 remarks calling AIPAC money America-last and rejecting the antisemitism label for AIPAC criticism.
why_interesting: Carlson used Kirk's own stage to say taking AIPAC money is America-last and that Kirk had been falsely branded antisemitic for the exact criticism Carlson was repeating.

title: Megyn Kelly, AmFest, and Donor Pressure
description: Megyn Kelly's role across the AmFest record — the GO MAX capture, Kirk's donor-pressure interview, and Shapiro's attack.
why_interesting: On August 6, 2025, days after the alleged Hamptons confrontation, Kirk went on Kelly's show and publicly lashed out about donors pressuring him and about texts calling him an antisemite.

title: Dave Smith: Stage Booking and Donor Ire
description: Dave Smith's July 2025 Israel debate against Josh Hammer and the donor anger it reportedly produced.
why_interesting: Recap accounts claim both live and online audiences favored Smith and that donors were irate with Kirk for it; Hammer reportedly appeared at an Ackman Hamptons weekend soon after.

title: X Discourse: Pro-Israel Speaker Pressure
description: Raw archive of X posts about donor and influencer pressure over who was allowed on the AmFest stage.
why_interesting: Preserves the widely recycled claim that Kirk meant to pair Candace with Tucker at AmFest to make TPUSA 'anti-Zionist America Only' — plus the later 'Erika has now replaced Tucker with Ben Shapiro' variant.

title: AI Voice and Memorial Tech
description: How TPUSA AI voice cloning of Kirk and memorial-scale phone tracking changed the authentication standard for audio evidence.
why_interesting: TPUSA-adjacent programming reportedly used AI voice cloning to produce 'Charlie from beyond the grave' content — meaning any leaked Kirk audio now needs cryptographic provenance, not a vibe check.

title: Who Actually Runs AmFest
description: Operational control of AmericaFest — TPUSA events leadership and the outside live-production vendor.
why_interesting: Booking politics get the attention, but a senior TPUSA events executive and outside vendor Mosaic Pro Events control load-in, AV, camera angles and security interfaces — the functions that decide what gets recorded.

title: Bannon: We Are At War
description: Steve Bannon's December 19, 2025 AmericaFest remarks framing Kirk's death in war and martyr language.
why_interesting: Bannon reportedly told the first AmFest without Kirk 'We are at war' and ranked Kirk among the greatest Americans since the Revolution — war framing that can crowd out forensic investigation.

title: AmericaFest December 2025
description: The first AmericaFest held without Charlie Kirk, in Phoenix, and the main-stage fights that defined it.
why_interesting: The conference Kirk programmed sixteen days before his death ran anyway with roughly 30,000-plus attendees, broadcasting AIPAC criticism, war rhetoric and purity policing from one stage.

title: Open Questions and Checklist
description: Documentary work order listing the contracts, transcripts and extractions that would settle the AmFest claims.
why_interesting: Names the exact documents nobody has produced: any written veto or rescind request for Carlson, the flyer's design revision history, and a device-level export rather than screenshots of the publicized texts.

title: AmFest Speaker Index by Year
description: Year-by-year list of who spoke at AmericaFest and TPUSA summits, sourced to published lineups.
why_interesting: Documents from TPUSA's own YouTube playlists that Carlson closed AmFest 2024's first night and Bannon closed the event with a 'Victory or Death!' call to action.

title: Booking a Speaker as Policy
description: The method behind treating conference invitations as falsifiable public policy signals rather than crime evidence.
why_interesting: Argues bookings are a published, falsifiable record — so a sustained post-death inversion of Kirk's last known speaker preferences would be a measurable signal, not a vibe.

title: Debra Carlson Name Search (AmFest)
description: A negative research result: no public material found linking a Debra or Deborah Carlson to the AmFest record.
why_interesting: A rare published negative: a dedicated 2026 search across X, the master file and the site found zero hits, recorded so nobody later invents a role for an unmatched name.

title: What AmericaFest Actually Is
description: Background on AmericaFest — TPUSA's multi-day December Phoenix conference, its scale, format and function.
why_interesting: Explains why a conference schedule lands in a homicide file: AmFest is a recruiting funnel, content studio and donor floor, with separate VIP areas and continuous main-stage clip production.

title: AmFest (AmericaFest)
description: Index page for the AmFest section, linking every speaker-fight, timeline and donor-pressure page.
why_interesting: Frames AmericaFest as the single stage recurring most often in the whole investigation, and routes to the September 9 Candace text and the August 25 flyer.

title: Analysis Documentation
description: Hub page for evidence synthesis and research findings, with forensic bullet-engraving photos and links to proposed disclosure laws.
why_interesting: Links to forensic lab photos of engraved rifle cartridges and notes that the full FBI Form 302 reports, the complete autopsy, and UVU cell-tower dumps remain unreleased.

description: Covers UVU pre-event security records, GRAMA-released September 9 communications, staffing levels, and the campus alert failures.
why_interesting: Two unidentified men reportedly walked into a UVU office at 10:35 PM on Sept 9 asking to tell police about "a plan"; the first campus alert falsely said "suspect in custody" and names are redacted.

title: 2025 Political Pressure and Key Meetings Before UVU (Claims)
description: Chronology of 2025 donor pressure, White House and Hamptons meetings, and reported private texts before the UVU event.
why_interesting: Charlie reportedly texted Dan Flood the night of Sept 9 that he would be "executed tomorrow," and ~48 hours earlier wrote donor pressure was forcing him to leave the pro-Israel cause.

title: Reported Pre-Event Searches and Reconnaissance (Claims)
description: Catalogs Google Trends and OSINT claims of search spikes for UVU layouts, surgeons, attorneys, and people in Kirk's orbit.
why_interesting: A reported July 2025 spike in searches for six named Timpanogos surgeons, plus December 2024 interest in defense attorney Kathryn Nester — months before any shooting or arrest.

title: Heightened Political Tensions Before UVU
description: Maps July-September 2025 escalation: donor friction, warning statements, aircraft movements, and TPUSA governance and insurance claims.
why_interesting: Egyptian aircraft SU-BTT reportedly departed Utah at 7:08 MT the morning of Sept 10, and a GGLF 2023 LLC policy on Kirk allegedly carried an estimated $20M-$50M payout.

title: State Department and Diplomatic Response (Claims)
description: Examines State Department condemnation, visa revocations, and pre-event Egyptian diplomatic flights into Provo with DOD-liaison narratives.
why_interesting: Egyptian jet SU-BTT reportedly made Provo stops September 4-10 under DOD-liaison contractor narratives, while State revoked visas of foreigners who celebrated the death.

title: Woke-Right Defamation Frame (July 31 Context)
description: Explains the "woke-right" label, the July 31 White House session framing, and the Hamptons attendee roster claims.
why_interesting: An off-record July 31 White House session was reportedly organized around "woke-right defamation" of Israel — with TPUSA, Kirk's own organization, notably absent from the room.

title: Political Violence Debates (2024-2025 Context)
description: Surveys the 2024-2025 political violence backdrop, competing post-shooting narratives, and hostile rhetoric circulating before the UVU event.
why_interesting: Commentary compilations report a public call for Tucker Carlson to be "neutralized," and rhetoric about applying pager-operation "energy" against Americans, weeks before September 10.

title: MAGA Movement and Antisemitism Debate (2025)
description: Lays out the competing frames in the 2025 MAGA antisemitism argument and Kirk's reported position going into the Hamptons meetings.
why_interesting: Kirk's reported refusal to deplatform critical voices put him on the wrong side of the donor-aligned frame just weeks before the August 4-6 Hamptons "intervention."

title: Before Events
description: Section overview summarizing the August 4 to September 10 pressure, reconnaissance, and aircraft threads before the UVU event.
why_interesting: Ties the Sept 9 all-caps text "THEY ARE GOING TO KILL ME" to the same window as May-July Google Trends spikes for UVU rooftops and parking.

title: Before Investigation Index
description: Routing hub mapping pre-September 10 research questions to the Level 3 pages covering meetings, recon, aircraft, and campus warnings.
why_interesting: A question-routing table treats donor meetings, Google Trends recon, and pre-event aircraft as parallel open investigative lanes rather than settled background.

description: Uncompressed four-channel broadcast audio recorded 46 meters from the tent and the acoustic events analysts say it separates.
why_interesting: Analysts say the uncompressed track separates three low-frequency events, with the loudest at +321 ms originating at the stage itself, plus 733 supersonic N-wave signatures versus 123 on the best phone.

title: Tyler as a Placeholder Figure
description: The contested argument that the figure on September 10 cameras was identified by caption and inference rather than any facial match.
why_interesting: The government's own affidavit notes the accused surrendered not wearing clothing consistent with the surveillance figure, and commentators reportedly contrast a morning waif-like figure with linebacker-shouldered enhanced stairwell stills.

description: Crowd phone footage, the 4K close-up witnesses say federal agents asked be deleted, and multi-angle shirt analysis.
why_interesting: Witness Ryne Simmons reportedly gave the FBI a 4K 60fps close-up and says federal investigators called repeatedly to confirm he deleted it; Jon Bray argues the shirt motion is incompatible with a .30-06 impact.

title: UVU Campus Surveillance
description: The institutional campus CCTV behind the probable-cause affidavit, its rooftop stills, and the disputes over what it does not show.
why_interesting: Testimony reportedly conceded the rooftop figure lacks identifiable facial features; one account alleges stairwell camera labels flip between "level 2 NE" and "level 1 NE" over the same parked white car.

title: Tyler on Surveillance Cameras
description: Master table of every camera sighting the released timeline attributes to the accused across September 10 and 11.
why_interesting: The whole chain hinges on an unrecorded outfit change, and high-engagement posts ask how one person is shown running through the UVU courtyard and on the Losee rooftop at the same 12:23 p.m. second.

title: Merchant & Travel CCTV
description: Dairy Queen, Cedar City Maverik, and sheriff lobby cameras that test the afternoon and evening movements.
why_interesting: Commentary alleges the Washington County Sheriff lobby CCTV of the surrender is gone and no intake bodycam exists — a "double deletion" that would otherwise test the disputed 7:57 p.m. Discord message.

title: Surveillance Cameras
description: Hub page summarizing every camera thread, plus the witness account of being told to erase his footage.
why_interesting: A witness says an FBI contact advised him to erase his video because it would only give him PTSD, then called back to confirm — so he published it and copied it across many drives instead.

title: WYZE Cameras
description: Two WYZE neighborhood camera sightings on W 880 S — driving at 8:23 a.m. and walking at 9:57 a.m.
why_interesting: These two timestamps are load-bearing for the "one continuous person" morning chain, and Baron Coleman's shadow analysis reportedly argues the doorbell-timeline clock does not match the sun angles.

title: Cameras Investigation Index
description: Routing index mapping every lens that may have recorded September 10 to its dedicated page.
why_interesting: Its priority watch list flags crime-scene camera handling — alleged SD card removal and a flash-drive-versus-original chain-of-custody question — as an open thread alongside withheld TPUSA angles.

title: Campus & University
description: Hub page on UVU as both campus and crime scene: CCTV, rooftop access, event security, and evidence handling.
why_interesting: At the July 2026 preliminary hearing, Agent David Hull was reportedly cross-examined on the rooftop search and the absence of a shell casing; commentators also note TPUSA media drones flew while security drones were denied.

title: Cause of Death
description: States what citizen investigators concluded killed Charlie Kirk and why the .30-06 rifle account is rejected.
why_interesting: The state's own ATF exam reportedly could not match the recovered fragment to the recovered rifle; witnesses near the stage described a chest event, and the autopsy remains unreleased.

title: Ryne Simmons — FBI Video Deletion
description: Witness who filmed the assassination in close-up says federal FBI contacts repeatedly told him to delete the footage.
why_interesting: Simmons reportedly captured 4K 60fps close-up video, sent it to the FBI, and says national-level agents called multiple times to ensure it was erased; he says he kept a copy.

title: Witness Footage Pressure
description: Attendee accounts of phone video vanishing or being edited, deletion requests, and an SD card reportedly removed before police secured the area.
why_interesting: An executive who reportedly removed an SD card had allegedly never attended another university event; attendees say clips were missing or altered by the time they got home.

title: Court Gag Orders
description: Judicial gag orders in State v. Robinson and the judge-swap timing that investigators say silenced witnesses and counsel.
why_interesting: Judge Tony Graf reportedly issued a gag order on his own motion December 16 2025 — neither side asked for it — weeks after the prior judge retired August 1 and Graf took over August 4.

title: TPUSA Legal Threats
description: Reported cease-and-desist letters and private legal pressure aimed at citizen investigators publishing drone and donor material.
why_interesting: TPUSA reportedly later admitted a media production drone flew before the event while the security team's counter-drone request was denied — after legal threats over drone-footage contradictions.

title: X — Candace Owens Engagement Bans
description: Reported mass X suspensions and shadowbans triggered simply by liking or replying to Candace Owens posts about the assassination.
why_interesting: @ProjectConstitu reports thousands of accounts suspended, locked, or flagged "limited visibility" for merely liking or reposting Kirk-related Candace Owens threads on maroon shirts and foreign money.

title: Google Search & Trends Scrubbing
description: Claims that Google Trends records of pre-event UVU searches were deleted and that investigation sites are hard to find.
why_interesting: Investigators allege deletion of Trends data showing May–July 2025 spikes for "UVU Rooftop", "Losee Center", parking and CCTV layout — apparent scouting searches — plus unverified Israeli-IP searches on the judges.

title: X — Poll About Kirk Narrative Reportedly Blocked
description: Two X accounts report that a poll asking whether people still believe the .30-06 narrative would not publish as a poll.
why_interesting: On August 2 2026 @QueenOfRespawn said her poll "failed to send and goes to drafts"; @SwordTruth said the same text posted with no poll attached — screenshot of the loaded composer included.

title: X — Deboosting Investigators
description: Reported algorithmic reach suppression on X for accounts posting ballistics, FBI, and foreign-nexus threads about the case.
why_interesting: Investigators report impressions collapsing right after posting on ballistics or intelligence topics, while official UVU posts stayed visible — soft suppression that leaves posts technically up but unspread.

title: X — EU €120M DSA Fine
description: The European Commission's first-ever Digital Services Act fine against X, and why regulators over that platform matter to this case.
why_interesting: On December 5 2025 the Commission fined X €120 million (~$140M) — its first DSA penalty — over blue-check design, the ad repository, and researcher data access; the platform where nearly all citizen investigation lives.

title: Platform — YouTube & Meta
description: Reported age restrictions, demonetization, and strikes on long-form Kirk investigation video, plus Meta violence-policy removals.
why_interesting: Multi-hour ballistics and timeline breakdowns are reportedly hit with "harmful misinformation" strikes and demonetization at rates creators say exceed ordinary political content, pushing evidence to Rumble, BitChute, and IPFS.

title: Censorship Investigation Index
description: Working memo routing every suppression thread by channel — platforms, courts, witnesses — plus preservation counter-measures.
why_interesting: Investigators treat censorship as an explanation for gaps in the record rather than proof itself, and answer it with IPFS pinning of evidence files that cannot be taken down from any single host.

title: Censorship
description: Section overview tying platform bans, court gag orders, legal threats, and witness pressure into one suppression picture.
why_interesting: Former NCTC director Joe Kent has said on the record that his center's parallel review of possible foreign ties to the case was ordered to stop before its leads were exhausted.

title: Star Witness In His Own Words
description: Sam Parker's August 2026 post arguing Charlie Kirk's own private communications are the case's strongest untapped evidence.
why_interesting: Parker lists a chain: private kill-me statements, public bullying complaint, a Sept 9 declaration he was leaving the pro-Israel cause, a Zoom call, then "They're going to kill me" that evening.

title: KM-07 — THEY ARE GOING TO KILL ME
description: The all-caps September 9 2025 message reportedly sent during or after a combative high-pressure meeting.
why_interesting: The single most-quoted line in the case has never been produced: no screenshot, no carrier record, no law-enforcement filing authenticating it as a Kirk SMS, Signal, or Telegram export.

title: Epstein Files Push
description: Claims Kirk pressed for Epstein files release and refused a reported July 12 2025 order from Trump to back off.
why_interesting: Compiled notes allege Trump phoned Kirk on July 12, 2025 reprimanding his Epstein coverage and ordering him to stop; Kirk reportedly refused. He was killed under two months later.

title: Phone Surveillance Claims
description: Allegations Kirk's phone was surveilled, a donor threatened him, and a Hamptons intervention followed.
why_interesting: An unnamed TPUSA mega-donor, voice digitally altered, reportedly warned Kirk he "won't make it to Christmas." Kirk described an overheating phone, call feedback, and a second SIM he never installed.

title: Netanyahu / Iran Intervention Call
description: Attributed claims that Kirk's final high-pressure call involved Netanyahu-aligned pressure to back war with Iran.
why_interesting: Candace Owens and large amplifiers claim Kirk's last major call was an intervention pushing U.S. war footing on Iran, which he refused; TPUSA messaging allegedly flipped pro-war after his death.

title: SUV 911 and Get That Off of Him
description: Claims about audio from the security vehicle after the shot, including two circulating spoken lines.
why_interesting: Circulating audio tips include "We got him" and "Get that off of him."

title: Missing 911 / Harpole Claims
description: A records dispute over a 911 call Kirk's security contractor says he made that has not been produced.
why_interesting: Kirk's security contractor reportedly told Shawn Ryan he called 911, yet no matching government call record has surfaced — framed online as either a misstatement or withheld records, "both terrible options."

title: KM-09 — Three People Warned
description: The claim Kirk told three separate people on September 9 that he thought they were going to kill him.
why_interesting: None of the three has ever been publicly identified and none has produced a message; Owens has declined to name one, described as a TPUSA staffer. The site marks this as where documentation stops.

title: They Are Going to Kill Me
description: Master index of the alleged September 9 2025 texts warning that he would be killed.
why_interesting: Investigators catalogue thirteen numbered distinct kill-me statements with conflicting wording, recipients, and platforms — Signal and Telegram claims sit beside a gap where no public screenshot exists.

title: Leave Pro-Israel WhatsApp Chat
description: The September 2025 donor WhatsApp chat attributed to Kirk, publicly authenticated by TPUSA's spokesman.
why_interesting: This is the rare item TPUSA spokesman Andrew Kolvet publicly confirmed as real: Kirk reportedly lost a large donor over Tucker Carlson and wrote he was leaving the pro-Israel cause days before dying.

title: Dan Flood Security Texts
description: Claims Kirk texted his security lead the night before UVU saying he would be killed or executed tomorrow.
why_interesting: The alleged recipient of "they will execute me tomorrow" was reportedly Kirk's own head of security, who was in day-of proximity at UVU — a warning to the person responsible for preventing it.

title: KM-08 — Kolvet They Will Kill Me
description: The short September 9 2025 "they will kill me" message reportedly sent to Andrew Kolvet.
why_interesting: The same TPUSA spokesman who publicly authenticated the donor WhatsApp chat is also the reported recipient of a "they will kill me" message the day before the assassination.

title: September 9 Kill-Me Cluster
description: The set of alleged September 9 2025 warnings, their recipients, Signal claims, and the widow's denial.
why_interesting: Multiple named commentators place fear messages on the exact day before the shooting, reportedly sent over Signal rather than iMessage — a channel choice that would leave the family phone clean.

title: They Will Kill Me If I Break Away
description: The August 13 2025 line attributed to Kirk about being killed for breaking with pro-Israel politics.
why_interesting: Nearly a month before the assassination Kirk reportedly said "They will kill me if I break away from being pro-Israel" — a dated, indexed statement predicting the manner of his own death.

title: Harrison Smith August 13 X Post
description: A contemporaneous public X post from August 13 2025 relaying Kirk's fear of being killed.
why_interesting: Unlike most kill-me claims, this one was posted publicly on August 13, 2025 — 28 days before the shooting — so it is timestamped and cannot have been invented afterward.

title: If I Go Against Israel Quote
description: The August 16 2025 line "Hey, if I go against Israel, I think they will kill me" and its date conflict.
why_interesting: Two separately indexed statements, August 13 and August 16, carry nearly identical meaning — investigators track whether they are one event misdated or Kirk repeating the fear to different people.

title: Frank Turek — They Want Me Dead
description: Messages Kirk's Christian mentor says he received: "I know they want me dead… please pray for me."
why_interesting: Kirk's own apologetics mentor states on the record that Kirk wrote "I know they want me dead… under the gun… please pray for me" — a named adult witness, not an anonymous screenshot.

title: Dan Flood — Executed Tomorrow
description: Owens reporting that Kirk told his head of security he would be executed the next day.
why_interesting: The word reportedly used was "executed" — not shot or attacked — language implying a planned, sanctioned killing rather than a random lone gunman.

title: Donors Play Into Stereotypes Line
description: The alleged WhatsApp line about donor bullying sent roughly 48 hours before the assassination.
why_interesting: "I cannot and will not be bullied like this" was reportedly written about 48 hours before he was killed — and unlike most quotes in the case, the chat it sits in was publicly confirmed authentic.

title: Candace and Kolvet Authentication
description: How Owens published the donor WhatsApp material and how TPUSA's spokesman publicly confirmed it.
why_interesting: TPUSA's own spokesman confirmed on the record that the leaked donor chat was genuine — meaning the organization has conceded Kirk was under donor pressure days before he died.

title: Leaving The Pro-Israel Cause Line
description: The alleged message roughly 48 hours before death announcing a political break with the pro-Israel cause.
why_interesting: Investigators treat this as the motive hinge: a message reportedly telling donor-side recipients he was leaving the cause, sent about two days before he was assassinated.

title: September 9 Shapiro Appearance
description: Kirk's publicly recorded September 9 2025 appearance showing Israel-policy friction the day before UVU.
why_interesting: This is verifiable on video, not hearsay: the day before he was killed Kirk appeared on Ben Shapiro's show displaying open Israel-policy friction with an allied host.

title: Iran War Opposition
description: Kirk's 2025 public and reported private opposition to a U.S. war with Iran during the Midnight Hammer period.
why_interesting: Kirk was actively lobbying against a U.S.–Iran war in 2025 — putting him against the most powerful foreign-policy push of the year in the weeks before he was killed.

title: Joe Kent Last Conversation
description: A senior counterterrorism official's account of Kirk's final message to him.
why_interesting: Joe Kent, a sitting U.S. counterterrorism official, says Kirk's last message to him was to stop a war with Iran — placing anti-war lobbying in Kirk's final communications.

title: AIPAC Lobby Comments
description: Public comments attributed to Kirk about AIPAC and lobbying pressure, including circulated treason framing.
why_interesting: Kirk reportedly used "treason" framing about foreign-lobby pressure on U.S. politics — the kind of statement investigators treat as the pressure surface that made him a target.

title: Gaza Remarks
description: Circulated comments in which Kirk allegedly warned about ethnic cleansing in Gaza and questioned official narratives.
why_interesting: A newcomer expecting an unwavering pro-Israel activist finds Kirk reportedly warning about ethnic cleansing in Gaza and openly questioning the official narrative.

title: Israel Break Public Rhetoric
description: Synthesis of Kirk's 2025 public rhetorical shift on Israel across show clips and campus Q&A.
why_interesting: The break was not private: investigators assemble dated show clips and campus Q&A showing Kirk publicly moving away from his own movement's Israel line during 2025.

title: Donor Pressure On Air
description: Public comments where Kirk addressed donor bullying, funding threats, and refusing to cancel allies.
why_interesting: Kirk described donor bullying and funding threats on air — the public mirror of the private WhatsApp chat, meaning the pressure story is corroborated in two independent channels.

title: Signal and Telegram Channels
description: Why investigators say Kirk used Signal and Telegram for sensitive threat messages, and the forensic consequence.
why_interesting: If the warning messages went over Signal and Telegram rather than iMessage, a family member holding the iPhone could truthfully say she sees nothing while the messages still existed.

title: Security Detail Call Chain
description: Map of claimed day-of phone traffic among Kirk's security detail, outside teams, and 911.
why_interesting: The day-of call chain reconstruction shows outside security teams reportedly on the line during the critical minutes, with the carrier call-detail records still never produced.

title: Shapiro Security Call
description: Claims Ben Shapiro's security team was on the phone with Kirk's team during hospital transport.
why_interesting: Investigators report that another commentator's private security team was allegedly on the line with Kirk's team during the ambulance run — an odd party to the most critical minutes.

title: Wiped Out Premonition
description: Longer-running premonition language attributed to Kirk, including revolution texts to Candace Owens.
why_interesting: Well before the Israel-specific quotes, Kirk reportedly wrote that he could be "wiped out at any time" — showing the fear predated the 2025 donor fight.

title: Candace Owens Private Texts
description: Private texts between Kirk and Candace Owens including the revolution quote and 2023 defense messages.
why_interesting: Private threads show Kirk defending Owens against pressure as far back as 2023 and inviting her to AmFest on September 9 — the day before he died.

title: Authenticity and Fakes
description: How to separate confirmed WhatsApp material from meme screenshots and mislabeled-app fabrications.
why_interesting: The site itself flags that many viral kill-me screenshots are mislabeled or fabricated — a rare self-policing map showing exactly which items survive scrutiny and which do not.

title: Pre-Event Timeline
description: Chronology from July through September 9 2025 of meetings, reported warnings, and final texts.
why_interesting: Laid end to end, July to September 9 shows a compressed escalation: a reprimand call, a Hamptons intervention, a donor break, and warning texts — all inside eight weeks.

title: Reported Quotes and Warnings
description: Catalogue of alleged fear-of-death statements before September 10 2025 with sources and contradictions.
why_interesting: More than a dozen separate people-and-date pairings have Kirk predicting his own killing in the weeks before it happened, tracked here with each source's contradictions exposed.

title: Platform Mix-Ups
description: How viral posts confuse WhatsApp, Signal, SMS, and Discord, and why the label changes authentication.
why_interesting: Mislabeling which app a message came from quietly destroys its authentication path — a mechanism by which real evidence gets dismissed as fake and fake evidence gets treated as real.

title: Charlie Investigation Index
description: Working memo on the victim-and-motive angle: pre-event pressure, warnings, and security posture.
why_interesting: The friction checklist stacks a reported refused $150M donation, a DOGE audit order about a week before the shooting, and a board removal eight days prior into one motive picture.

title: Companies & Organizations
description: Master index of every company, LLC, non-profit, U.S. agency, and foreign intelligence body profiled in the investigation.
why_interesting: Lists explosives maker Accurate Energetic Systems under the exploding-mic theory alongside Mossad, the CIA, and a web of TPUSA-linked LLCs including aviation entity LASAI Aviation II, operator of N1098L (Claims).

title: CIA, DARPA and DEW Mind Control
description: Separates documented patents, an Air Force volume and DARPA programs from the assertions layered on top in a July 2026 compilation.
why_interesting: A genuine 1994 Air Force "New World Vistas" passage describes pulsed electromagnetic energy to "control emotions and thus actions" and "transmit suggestions"; researcher Nick Begich says such weapons leave "no entry or exit wound."

title: Havana Syndrome
description: Anomalous Health Incidents, the contradictory 2020 and 2023 official findings, Pentagon device testing, and July 2026 whistleblower claims.
why_interesting: The 2020 National Academies named pulsed RF the most plausible mechanism, yet a 2023 seven-agency review called foreign attack "very unlikely" — while CBS reported in January 2026 the Pentagon had been testing such a device for over a year.

title: Directed Energy Weapons
description: Fielded lasers, high-power microwave, Active Denial and pulsed RF systems versus alleged behavior-control claims circulating about the case.
why_interesting: The Active Denial System already projects a 95 GHz beam to create sensation in a human at range, and the Frey microwave-hearing effect has been replicated physics since 1961 — the acknowledged floor is far above public assumption.

title: Brain-to-Brain Communications
description: Published brain-to-brain interface experiments and their hard limits, against alleged operational intelligence systems named in whistleblower testimony.
why_interesting: Peer-reviewed brain-to-brain links are real: BrainNet (2018) moved a decision between three people at roughly 81% accuracy via EEG and TMS-induced phosphenes — though bandwidth was about one bit.

title: Covert Communications
description: Conventional tradecraft for unattributable message-passing, and the competing implant/nanotech usage of the same phrase in whistleblower claims.
why_interesting: Ordinary tradecraft — dead drops, numbers stations, cut-outs, Discord — already produces the exact public appearance of a self-motivated lone shooter, with no exotic physics needed to hide a handler.

title: Communication by Consciousness
description: Declassified Stargate-era remote viewing funding and why documented intelligence interest is not proof of any capability used at UVU.
why_interesting: U.S. intelligence funded remote viewing for 23 years under SCANATE, Grill Flame, Center Lane, Sun Streak and Stargate; the 1995 CIA-commissioned review split, with statistician Jessica Utts finding a significant effect.

title: Consciousness Control
description: Section entry page mapping technologies that touch perception and behavior, and the question of whether the accused acted alone.
why_interesting: States the section's core thesis outright: capabilities exist that can make a political shooter look like a lone "crazy person," and public discourse often runs years ahead of declassification.

title: 6:25 PM Custody & the Discord Confession
description: How the 6:25 PM Miranda timestamp on exhibit Bates 003996-R2 collides with the 7:57 PM Discord confession attributed to Tyler Robinson.
why_interesting: A defense filing quotes video exhibit Bates 003996-R2: Robinson Mirandized 6:25 PM Sept 11 and asking for counsel at 6:26 PM — 90 minutes before the "It was me" Discord messages he allegedly typed.

title: Missing Bodycam & the GRAMA 'No Footage' Admission
description: A public-records appeal in which Washington County reportedly stated no bodycam footage of Robinson's surrender exists at all.
why_interesting: At a GRAMA hearing with Scripps News, the county's representative reportedly said "there was a search made for body cam footage and there was none" — after lobby CCTV of the surrender had also reportedly gone missing.

title: Baron Coleman: Early Turn-In & the Refused Surrender Video
description: Attorney Baron Coleman's argument that Robinson surrendered in the early afternoon and that surrender video was refused to a news outlet.
why_interesting: Coleman says he has heard Robinson turned himself in "as early as three p.m." — and that when a news organization requested the surrender footage, Washington County reportedly refused to provide it.

title: Mirandizing — Court Evidence
description: Hub for the custody-timing dispute: when Robinson was taken into custody and when his phone was seized.
why_interesting: Washington County protocol seizes a suspect's phone at Mirandizing; if that happened at 6:25 PM, the record that would settle authorship of the confession — unedited custody video and phone-seizure logs — is precisely what has not been released.

title: Ballistics — ATF Inconclusive & CBLA
description: The ATF laboratory comparison of the autopsy bullet jacket fragment to the seized Mauser rifle and its inconclusive result.
why_interesting: The ATF report on autopsy Exhibit 6A could neither identify nor exclude the seized Mauser 98 — the rifling was consistent with "numerous makes and models," leaving no bullet-to-rifle link at all.

title: Cellebrite — Israeli Forensics Firm
description: The Israeli digital-forensics company named in sworn testimony as the tool used to extract Lance Twiggs' phone data.
why_interesting: Courtroom testimony reportedly confirmed an Israeli company, Cellebrite, produced the phone forensics in a U.S. capital case in which commentators treat Israeli involvement as an open investigative question.

title: Forensic Phone Extraction
description: Testimony describing a completed Cellebrite extraction of Twiggs' phone, against the prosecution's filed position on forensic extractions.
why_interesting: A prosecution filing reportedly said the state "does not intend to offer evidence obtained through forensic extractions" — then an agent testified in open court to reviewing exactly such an extraction.

title: Preliminary Hearing — Day 4
description: Full transcript: the Twiggs immunized interview, the confession texts, rifle recovery, and ATF ballistics testimony.
why_interesting: Verbatim transcript of the day the defense's own ATF examiner testified the autopsy bullet jacket could not be matched to the recovered rifle — in the same session the "confession" texts were read aloud.

title: Discord Evidence in Court
description: The Discord messages attributed to Robinson and the custody-timing questions about who could have typed them.
why_interesting: A government document reportedly logs 8:04 PM sheriff-to-sheriff calls and a 10:00 PM booking-sheet arrest time, while the police database records 4:00 AM Sept 12 — three different arrest times in one record set.

title: Preliminary Hearing — Day 1 (July 2026)
description: Full color-coded transcript of day one: rooftop testimony from Officer Bagley and Agent Hull on surveillance and autopsy.
why_interesting: A 5,300-line verbatim transcript in which the judge turns off counsel microphones for security and the officer who found the "sniper pad" says his body camera stopped recording as he arrived.

title: Testimony
description: What witnesses said under oath at the 2026 preliminary hearing, what is contested, and where the record has gaps.
why_interesting: No video exists of the rooftop scene at all — the record of the disturbed gravel and the red-and-black screwdriver rests on one officer's recollection months later, with a badge-carrier beside him whose name he never obtained.

title: Discovery & Brady Disputes
description: FBI and ATF materials the defense says were withheld, plus the reported 600,000-file production.
why_interesting: Citizen investigators allege the state "drowned" the defense in roughly 600,000 files while ballistics scans, DNA mixture data and chain-of-custody logs held since September 2025 reportedly stayed unproduced.

title: Lance Twiggs' Phone
description: The roommate's device that produced the alleged Robinson–Twiggs texts, and the authentication questions around it.
why_interesting: The confession-style texts came off a third party's phone, not Robinson's — and were reportedly released as photographs of messages rather than the device data itself.

title: Preliminary Hearing — Day 2
description: Full transcript: Agent Hull's surveillance walk-through, Cellebrite extractions, and Michael Burt's chain-of-custody cross.
why_interesting: Verbatim record of the surveillance montage the state used to identify Robinson, cross-examined line by line on chain of custody by a capital defender who also handled the Menendez retrial.

title: Judge Tony F. Graf Jr.
description: The presiding judge's appointment timeline, gag order, closed hearings, and the contempt finding against a prosecutor.
why_interesting: Graf was sworn in weeks before the shooting and the case is reportedly his first on the bench — the same window in which Salt Lake City's FBI field office reportedly changed leadership, per attributed commentary.

title: Gag Orders & Sealing
description: The December 2025 gag order, closed hearings, and the March 2026 fight over sealing the ATF report.
why_interesting: The judge reportedly issued a broad gag order on his own motion — neither side asked for it — and the defense then moved to seal a 4-page ATF report it simultaneously called exculpatory.

title: Preliminary Hearing — Day 3
description: Full transcript: Agent Davis on the surrender and booking, and the fight over broadcasting the Twiggs interview.
why_interesting: Verbatim record including testimony about a live .223 round found on a rooftop — a caliber unrelated to the .30-06 narrative — and an extended fight over whether the public could see the Twiggs video.

title: Tyler Robinson's Phone & Devices
description: What is and is not established about the defendant's own seized electronics and extractions.
why_interesting: The public record on the defendant's own phone is thinner than for his roommate's — commentators called the screenshot-only exhibit presentation "weird" and no full extraction report has surfaced.

title: 07/10/2026 — Preliminary Hearing Day 5
description: Final prelim day: ATF DNA statistics, the State resting, and the September 1 bind-over argument.
why_interesting: Under cross, the ATF DNA section chief reportedly conceded lab policy bars calling DNA infallible or zero-error-rate and that third-party transfer of DNA is possible.

title: Grok AI Analysis: Mirandizing Date
description: Hosted AI analysis PDF of the Bates 003996-R2 exhibit and the September 11 versus September 12 Miranda question.
why_interesting: Hosts the full analysis PDF arguing any Discord or text package timed after 6:25 PM Sept 11 must be authenticated against custody and phone-seizure records that have not been released.

title: Image: Sept 11 Grok Screenshot — Bates 003996-R2 Analysis
description: Screenshot and OCR of an AI analysis identifying what the Bates 003996-R2 discovery exhibit is.
why_interesting: The OCR'd analysis states Robinson was already in custody, Mirandized and had invoked counsel hours before the official "surrender" narrative and before the Discord confession attributed to him.

title: Image: Mirandized Sept 11 — Bates 003996-R2 Reference
description: Screenshot with OCR documenting the Bates exhibit timestamp and the separate official arrest record.
why_interesting: The same records set logs two different events: a Miranda encounter the evening of September 11 and a formal arrest recorded at 4:00 AM September 12 — roughly ten hours apart.

title: 06/2026 — Ballard Contempt
description: The civil contempt finding against a Utah County deputy attorney for pretrial publicity.
why_interesting: A sitting prosecutor was reportedly held in civil contempt for publicly talking up case strength after the inconclusive ATF report — and the state was ordered to pay defense fees.

title: Jaxson Fox — Informant Transport Order
description: A transport order for an inmate held in the same jail as Robinson, and the jailhouse-informant theories around it.
why_interesting: Judge Graf reportedly ordered the transport of an inmate facing unrelated child-related charges who is housed in Robinson's jail; commentators infer an informant role, which is their theory, not a court finding.

title: Counterpoint: The 24-Hour Investigative Hold
description: The strongest counterargument to the Miranda-timing claim, and why investigators say it misses the point.
why_interesting: Even granting that a 14.5-hour delay before formal Miranda is legal under an investigative hold, that rule answers whether the delay was lawful — not who physically typed the 7:57 PM confession.

title: 03/10/2026 — Seal Motion / ATF Fight
description: The March 2026 sealing fight over the inconclusive ATF ballistics report and the media coalition's opposition.
why_interesting: A media coalition argued the obvious: if the defense calls the ATF material exculpatory, why seal it? The report was later unsealed and remained inconclusive while the capital prosecution continued.

title: 07/07/2026 — Preliminary Hearing Day 2
description: Day two summary: surveillance walk-through, rifle in a towel, and the FBI DNA examiner called by the defense.
why_interesting: Testimony reportedly acknowledged the crime scene was paved over — with the case agent saying he learned of it via news — and described an unfired round on another roof attributed to an officer's rifle.

title: Utah County Jail & Custody
description: Booking, restricted housing, and the arrest-time discrepancy between the booking sheet and the police database.
why_interesting: The inmate booking sheet reportedly lists a 10:00 PM September 11 arrest while the police database records 04:00 September 12 — a six-hour discrepancy on the same booking number 460956.

title: 07/09/2026 — Preliminary Hearing Day 4
description: Day four summary: the Twiggs recorded interview, the confession texts and note, rifle recovery, and inconclusive ballistics.
why_interesting: The defense, not the prosecution, called the ATF examiner who testified the autopsy jacket fragment could not be identified or excluded as coming from the seized rifle.

title: People on Witness Stand
description: Complete roster of live sworn witnesses, Rule 1102 recordings, and statements admitted through agents.
why_interesting: Exactly seven people took the live stand — and the only FBI witness of the entire week was called by the defense, not the prosecution. An unidentified badge-carrier on the roof never testified.

title: Prosecution Team — Utah County
description: The Utah County Attorney's Office roster, its evidence theory, and the contempt ruling against one deputy.
why_interesting: The same office that produced the Bates 003996-R2 Miranda exhibit is reported to be moving the autopsy fragment to FBI Virtual Comparison Microscopy after ATF returned inconclusive.

title: Preliminary Hearing & Motions
description: Scheduling, delay motions, camera fights, and roommate-testimony disputes ahead of the July 2026 hearing.
why_interesting: A prosecution filing reportedly indicated it might not offer full forensic extractions from seized electronics at the preliminary hearing — the same category of evidence testimony later relied on.

title: 07/06/2026 — Preliminary Hearing Day 1
description: Day one summary: rooftop testimony, the body-cam gap, and the unidentified second badge-carrier.
why_interesting: The officer who reached the roof at 12:44 p.m. reportedly found an empty pistol holster in the grass, and his body-worn camera stopped recording — with a second badge-carrier beside him never identified.

title: Defense Team — Tyler Robinson
description: Lead counsel Kathryn Nester and co-counsel, their filings, and the projected cost of the capital defense.
why_interesting: Co-counsel includes the editor of California's Death Penalty Defense Manual and Menendez retrial counsel; research notes project $750,000+ for defense alone and roughly $1.3 million total.

title: Probable Cause Affidavit (Police Booking)
description: The full police probable-cause affidavit PDF and how its custody language is read against the Miranda timeline.
why_interesting: The affidavit's "early morning hours of September 12" language describes a later Utah County encounter after a multi-hour drive — not the 6:25 PM September 11 Miranda reading in the video exhibit.

title: 07/08/2026 — Preliminary Hearing Day 3
description: Day three summary: surrender and booking testimony plus the fight over publishing the Twiggs interview.
why_interesting: Testimony reportedly covered a rooftop .223 round and a family friend's handwritten Rule 1102 statement, while the parties argued under Estes v. Texas over broadcasting the roommate's recorded interview.

title: 12/16/2025 — Gag Order
description: The day the court restricted public commentary by every participant in the case.
why_interesting: The gag order was reportedly entered on the court's own motion — the legal hinge after which lawyers, witnesses and staff could no longer speak publicly about the assassination prosecution.

title: 05/08/2026 — Camera Access Motions
description: The May 2026 fight over courtroom cameras that shaped what the public could see of the July hearing.
why_interesting: This is why the public's view of the prelim is pool clips and partial exhibits rather than a complete video archive — the camera presence was highly managed with day-of fights over each exhibit.

title: Judge Robert Lunnen — Prior Bench Vacancy
description: The retirement that created the vacancy filled just before the capital case landed on the docket.
why_interesting: Lunnen left the bench August 1, 2025 — weeks before the shooting; unverified Google Trends claims allege searches for his name from Israeli IPs on May 15, 2025, before the assassination.

title: Case Overview — State v. Robinson
description: Caption, charges, custody, and pretrial posture in Case No. 251403576.
why_interesting: The baseline reference: capital aggravated-murder charges, no bail, booking #460956, and a defense whose central attack is the inconclusive ATF comparison on the autopsy bullet fragment.

title: FBI Asked a Witness to Delete Their Video (Claims)
description: Witness Ryne Simmons says he sent close-up shooting video to the FBI and was then told to delete it.
why_interesting: Simmons reportedly says the FBI told him to erase his close-up footage "to avoid PTSD" and phoned back to confirm he had. The FBI has not publicly confirmed this account.

title: 10 in. of dirt removed
description: Claim that roughly ten inches of soil was stripped from the UVU scene within about a day of the shooting.
why_interesting: Reportedly an unidentified team removed inches of soil before contractor Dan Merrell laid pavers under a claimed Governor/FBI "by Monday" deadline — a crime scene resurfaced within days.

title: The Exploding Microphone Theory (Claims)
description: The contested theory that an explosive at or in Kirk's microphone, not a rifle round, caused the fatal wound.
why_interesting: Citizen investigators argue the wound geometry fits a small charge at the mic rather than a distant .30-06 round, and say this possibility was never publicly tested.

title: Witness Videos Deleted Remotely From Phones (Claims)
description: Attendees reportedly found their own shooting footage missing or altered on their phones before reaching home.
why_interesting: Multiple attendees reportedly say video they shot vanished or changed on their own phones the same day, with nobody in the household deleting it — an unverified but repeatedly told account.

title: Inconclusive Ballistics, Sealed Report, and a Banned Test Revived (Claims)
description: The ATF ballistics report reportedly could not match the recovered fragment to the seized rifle, and was sealed.
why_interesting: An ATF lab report dated September 17, 2025 reportedly could neither match nor exclude the Mauser; critics say the state then sought new methods, including CBLA, a test the FBI abandoned in 2005.

title: Rifle Found Only After a Federal Redirect (Claims)
description: The rifle reportedly surfaced only on a repeat search ordered by federal agents after earlier searches found nothing.
why_interesting: An arm-to-arm sweep and a K-9 pass reportedly found no gun; only after federal agents told junior local officers to re-search did a towel-wrapped rifle appear.

title: Transport SUV Destroyed and Melted Down (Claims)
description: Claim that the SUV that carried Kirk to hospital was scrapped and melted before any independent forensic testing.
why_interesting: A primary forensic surface — blood-spatter geometry, tissue, possible device fragments — was reportedly "chopped into a thousand pieces" and melted down rather than preserved.

title: Rooftop-View Video Reportedly Trimmed and Withheld (Claims)
description: Critics say the released rooftop clip was cut to begin at 12:23:34 pm, after a runner was already sprinting.
why_interesting: The clip reportedly starts at 12:23:34 pm with the "runner" already 60 feet from the perch — timing critics argue makes the official rooftop shot impossible, with earlier seconds unreleased.

title: Standard Forensic Tests Reportedly Skipped (Claims)
description: Basic forensic steps including gunshot-residue testing and bomb dogs were reportedly bypassed at the scene.
why_interesting: No gunshot-residue test on the accused despite a same-clothes manhunt claim, bomb-sniffing dogs reportedly kept away, and an EMS crew reportedly turned away — steps that would have detected an explosive.

title: Hospital Footage Seized, ER Cleared, Staff NDAs (Claims)
description: Claims that FBI took Timpanogos hospital cameras, the ER was oddly empty, and staff signed NDAs.
why_interesting: Kirk was reportedly taken to Timpanogos (2.6 miles) rather than the larger Utah Valley Hospital; no footage from that day has surfaced and staff were reportedly made to sign NDAs.

title: CIA Reportedly Blocked From the Investigation (Claims)
description: Claim that FBI physically blocked CIA personnel from advancing the Charlie Kirk investigation.
why_interesting: Mike Glover said on the Mike Ritland Podcast (Ep. 270) that a high-level CIA official told him CIA agents were turned around at an airport and stopped from continuing their mission.

title: White House Escalation Halts Intelligence Leads (Claims)
description: Reported claims that foreign-nexus intelligence follow-up was escalated to a tense White House meeting and then stopped.
why_interesting: Per NYT and Daily Mail reporting cited here, intelligence work on foreign leads was reportedly blocked, escalated into a tense White House confrontation, and then ended without resolution.

title: FBI Halt of Joe Kent's Counterterrorism Leads (Claims)
description: Claim that NCTC director Joe Kent's foreign-nexus counterterrorism review was directed to stop.
why_interesting: Kent, NCTC director under DNI Tulsi Gabbard, reportedly opened a review into possible foreign involvement or foreknowledge — and that review was reportedly halted before he could run out his leads.

title: Officer's Body Camera Died on the Roof (Claims)
description: UVU Officer Chris Bagley's only body-cam recording reportedly ended exactly as he reached the Losee Center roof.
why_interesting: His single 27:35 recording reportedly ended on the roof before crime-scene tape went up — battery "must have died" — so no footage exists of the alleged sniper's nest or the DNA-linked screwdriver.

title: FBI Admitted Enhancing the Suspect Photos (Claims)
description: Claim that FBI released digitally enhanced BOLO photos after the suspect was already in custody.
why_interesting: A second set of stairwell images was reportedly pushed out as a public BOLO after Robinson was already in custody, and critics say morning and afternoon photos appear to show different people.

title: Key Officials Swapped in the Weeks Before the Event (Claims)
description: Judge, FBI field office head, and hospital CEO reportedly all changed in the weeks before September 10, 2025.
why_interesting: The presiding judge, the Salt Lake City FBI field-office head, and the treating hospital's CEO reportedly all took their posts in the weeks just before the shooting — the CEO reportedly joining surgery days later.

title: AES Tennessee Explosives Factory Explosion (Claims)
description: A Tennessee explosives plant blew up weeks after investigators tied a DoD munitions contract there to the case.
why_interesting: Accurate Energetic Systems in Humphreys County, Tennessee exploded October 10, 2025 — weeks after online investigators linked a Defense Department munitions contract there to the exploding-mic theory.

title: Autopsy Sealed and the Performing Examiner Kept Out of View (Claims)
description: The autopsy remains sealed and the pathologist who performed it has reportedly never been publicly named.
why_interesting: At the July 2026 preliminary hearing a DPS agent, not the pathologist, testified to the cause of death; the defense objected as hearsay because the examiner who did the autopsy was never called.

title: Utah Law Banning Public Sharing of Autopsy Photos and Video (Claims)
description: Utah S.B. 82 criminalized public sharing of non-public autopsy imagery four months before the assassination.
why_interesting: Utah S.B. 82 took effect May 7, 2025 — roughly four months before September 10 — making it a crime to publicly share non-public autopsy photographs and video.

title: Phone-Extraction Filing Contradicts Courtroom Testimony (Claims)
description: A prosecution filing disclaimed forensic-extraction evidence the state later relied on in court testimony.
why_interesting: The state's written filing reportedly said it did "not intend to offer evidence obtained through forensic extractions" — the same category as the publicly released message trail described later in testimony.

title: Cameras and SD Cards Removed From the Scene (Claims)
description: Event production staff, not police, reportedly pulled camera SD cards before any law-enforcement evidence seal.
why_interesting: TPUSA production staff reportedly secured or extracted recording media rather than preserving the scene, and Charlie Kirk's own microphone audio has reportedly never been released.

title: Local Police Reportedly Told Not to Interview Witnesses (Claims)
description: Claim that local officers were directed not to interview witnesses and were diverted to a distant location.
why_interesting: Based on police-radio traffic, proponents allege officers were told to stand down from interviewing and tied up at a decoy site, so untainted first-hand witness statements never entered the record.

title: Black-Clad Rooftop Suspect Dropped From the Narrative (Claims)
description: An early all-black-clad suspect in dispatch, eyewitness accounts, and rooftop footage reportedly disappeared from the case.
why_interesting: The day's earliest suspect description was a man dressed entirely in black, corroborated by an eyewitness and the only known rooftop footage — a lead that reportedly vanished once federal agents took over.

title: Free Trauma Counseling Used to Intimidate a Witness (Claims)
description: One witness's account that counseling offered exclusively to assassination witnesses became an intimidation session.
why_interesting: A UVU student who says he stood about 20 feet away reportedly accepted "free trauma counseling" advertised only to witnesses, and says the session turned into threats rather than therapy.

title: Archive.today
description: The FBI subpoenaed the registrar behind Archive.today fifty days after the killing, and the timing questions raised.
why_interesting: On October 30, 2025 — twenty days after the AES plant blast and fifty days after the killing — the FBI subpoenaed the registrar behind the one major web archive that is hard to delete from.

title: UVU HD Surveillance Never Publicly Released (Claims)
description: UVU's HD CCTV anchors the probable-cause affidavit yet only grainy re-encoded clips have been released.
why_interesting: The affidavit tracks a suspect across campus from ~11:50 am to 12:23 pm almost entirely on UVU cameras — while conceding that footage "does not capture the act of firing." Originals stay withheld.

title: Tyler Robinson Surrender Video Not Publicly Released (Claims)
description: Washington County Sheriff reportedly returned "no records" for surrender and booking video of Robinson.
why_interesting: KUTV 2News reports the sheriff's office returned "no records" for any surrender or booking footage — despite intake, dispatch, and body-worn systems that would normally capture those hours.

title: Airborne Surveillance Records Over UVU Withheld (Claims)
description: Army ISR jet passes and drone activity over UVU mean imagery may exist, but records are unproduced.
why_interesting: A U.S. Army HADES ISR jet, tail number N1098L, callsign AXLE10, is documented making low passes near the UVU corridor before and after the shooting; crew, tasking, and FAA records remain unreleased.

title: Fort Huachuca Records and JTF Reportedly Silenced (Claims)
description: A signals-intelligence lead at Fort Huachuca is kept untestable by withheld manifests, FOIA denials, and a recusal.
why_interesting: Commentators allege a signals-capable meeting at the Army's Intelligence Center of Excellence days before September 10 — with flight manifests withheld, FOIA denied, a Joint Task Force reassigned, and a judge recused.

title: Volunteer Defenders Reportedly Blocked, Jailhouse Informant Positioned (Claims)
description: Claims that volunteer attorneys were refused and an unrelated inmate was moved near the defendant.
why_interesting: Commentators say high-priced attorneys volunteering for the defense were turned away, and that a transport order moved inmate Jaxson Thomas Fox — with no documented case connection — into position as a possible informant.

title: Prosecutor's Daughter Was a Rally Witness (Claims)
description: A defense motion reports a senior Utah County prosecutor had a family member present at the rally.
why_interesting: A defense motion reportedly states the Chief Deputy County Attorney's family member was at the rally where Kirk was shot; the County Attorney declined an outside conflict screening. All presumed innocent.

title: Questions About How the Discord Confession Was Produced (Claims)
description: Provenance questions about the Discord confession, which surfaced as photos of a roommate's phone screen.
why_interesting: The "confession" reportedly first appeared as still photographs of someone else's phone screen, drip-released over months, never as an exportable log from a seized device or a sworn statement.

title: 600,000-File Document Dump and Withheld Raw Data (Claims)
description: A 600,000-file discovery production reportedly buried the defense while contested raw data stayed withheld.
why_interesting: The defense reportedly received a 600,000-file production while the FBI and ATF withheld the contested raw DNA, ballistics, and chain-of-custody data that would actually test the case.

title: Foreign-Agent Capture of the Kirk Show's Distribution (Claims)
description: Claims a FARA filing eight days after the killing covered messaging integration into the show's distributor.
why_interesting: A FARA filing tied to Brad Parscale's Clock Tower X LLC, reportedly dated September 18, 2025 — eight days after the killing — is said to cover Israeli-government work including "messaging integration into Salem Media properties."

title: UVU Records Redacted and Pre-Event Warnings Buried (Claims)
description: A GRAMA release reportedly shows pre-event warnings and an alert failure, with names redacted.
why_interesting: A Daily Caller News Foundation GRAMA request reportedly returned about 50 documents / 112 pages containing two pre-event flags and an alert breakdown — with identifying details redacted and more withheld.

title: Foreign-Nexus Flight Records Withheld (Claims)
description: Foreign flight leads rest on public ADS-B tracks because manifests and security waivers are undisclosed.
why_interesting: Trackers can see tail numbers, routes, and times — but manifests, cargo logs, visas, and security-exception waivers have not been disclosed, so the foreign leads can be neither confirmed nor killed.

title: 600+ Americans Punished for Kirk Comments (Claims)
description: A rapid wave of firings and suspensions reportedly punished 600+ people for posts about Kirk's death.
why_interesting: Teachers, nurses, flight attendants, and office workers — 600+ reportedly fired or suspended within weeks for social-media comments, a speed and volume critics say chilled discussion of the investigation itself.

title: Online Narrative-Control Operations (Claims)
description: Allegations that coordinated accounts, bots, and trolls steered online conversation about the assassination.
why_interesting: Investigators allege coordinated inauthentic accounts surged on the case's key threads, shaping which explanations spread and which were swarmed — presented as attributed, unproven allegations.

title: Censorship of Charlie Kirk Citizen Investigators (Claims)
description: Independent researchers report shadowbans, throttling, demonetization, and removals of their Kirk posts.
why_interesting: Researchers document reach collapsing on posts about the case specifically — not their other content — which they read as targeted throttling; ordinary moderation explanations are also given.

title: Blood Libel Branding Used to Kill Foreign Leads (Claims)
description: Claim that labeling foreign-nexus questions antisemitic functioned as rhetorical closure deterring records requests.
why_interesting: Questions about Israeli-registered phones near the venue or reported donor pressure were reportedly answered with the labels "antisemite" or "blood libel" rather than on the merits, deterring reporters from pressing.

title: Brian Harpole v. Candace Owens
description: Covers the defamation suit by Kirk's security chief against Candace Owens, the reported mass judicial recusal, and the public-figure dispute.
