description: Public flight data showing a private Utah-to-Nashville flight on the exact AES contract delivery date, framed as an open courier question.
why_interesting: A one-way private flight from Heber City, Utah — the closest general-aviation field to UVU — to Nashville, nearest airport to the AES plant, reportedly on August 25, 2025: the exact contract delivery deadline.

title: AES — Accurate Energetic Systems Factory Explosion
description: The Tennessee explosives plant tied to the contract was destroyed one month after the assassination.
why_interesting: On October 10, 2025 — a month after UVU — AES Building 602, reportedly holding ~24,000 lbs of explosives including PETN (the Hezbollah pager explosive), was obliterated; researchers say FOIA requests for overflight logs were denied.

title: Removing Explosive Residue Cover-Up
description: Hub cataloguing every surface and item that could have held explosive residue and was reportedly seized, cleaned, or destroyed.
why_interesting: Six separate items — the security team's clothing, the SUV, the necklace, ten inches of soil, the courtyard ground, a ceiling — were all reportedly removed, sealed, or resurfaced before any independent residue test was ever run.

title: FBI Seized Clothing From Charlie's Security Team
description: Candace Owens' secondhand account that federal agents took the security detail's clothing after the shooting.
why_interesting: Owens says she was told the FBI stripped certain members of Kirk's security detail "down to their boxer briefs" — the exact fabric that, per the residue page, would have trapped recoverable explosive traces.

title: 10 Inches of Dirt Hauled Away Immediately
description: Attributed claims that roughly ten inches of soil was stripped from under the UVU tent almost immediately.
why_interesting: Reportedly a crew removed about ten inches of soil from directly under the tent where Kirk was killed — before the weekend landscaping crew even arrived — the single surface most likely to hold PETN blowback.

title: Landscaping Crew Replaced Dirt With Cement / Pavers
description: A rushed hardscape crew paved over the courtyard spot where Charlie Kirk was killed.
why_interesting: The exact ground where Kirk fell was sealed under pavers within days — Rob O'Neill independently noted on NEWSMAX "I've been told they paved it over a couple days later."

title: Charlie Kirk's Necklace — Residue Search and Custody
description: Reported federal urgency to recover Kirk's cross necklace, and the competing accounts of how it was returned.
why_interesting: Candace Owens reads the unusual federal push to recover the cross necklace as an explosive-residue hunt; Frank Turek and Erika Kirk reportedly give conflicting recovery accounts, and no residue test has ever been made public.

title: Table Jumpers and the Missing Mic Device
description: Who reached Charlie within seconds, and whether the lavalier transmitter was taken off him in the chaos.
why_interesting: An FBI-agent wish-list item reportedly centers on people who went over the table within seconds; the mic pack's whereabouts are unaccounted for, and clips argue cameras were taken down and a chip pulled before the scene was sealed.

title: "Get That Off Of Him" — Alleged 911 Call Audio Tip
description: An unverified 23-second clip of an alleged 911 call from the security team.
why_interesting: On the alleged call, someone reportedly says "get that off of him." Unverified and secondhand.

title: SUV Transporting Charlie — Candace Owens Photos
description: Photos reportedly released by Candace Owens of the interior of the SUV that carried Kirk, examined for debris.
why_interesting: Citizen analysts say the CANDACE-watermarked photos of the black GMC Yukon show shattered tempered glass across the floor — the kind a fragmented RODE transmitter would scatter and a rifle round would not. TPUSA has not addressed it.

title: Burnt Object in the SUV — RODE Transmitter Claim
description: Project Constitution's claim identifying a burnt item in the SUV as the destroyed mic transmitter, plus the problems with it.
why_interesting: Project Constitution claims the charred object photographed in the SUV contains a melted audio jack and a fragment of the RODE battery label — a burnt device inside the vehicle a rifle shooting cannot explain.

title: The Exploding Pendant — Shaped-Charge Crucifix Theory
description: A former USMC explosive breacher's alternate theory that the charge was hidden in the crucifix pendant.
why_interesting: A former Marine explosive breacher argues a microscopic cone-shaped charge inside the crucifix — with the silver chain acting as the anchor that directs the jet — matches the wound better than any rifle round.

title: AV Team and Mic Setup
description: Who placed the microphone on Charlie Kirk and how the transmitter was routed that day.
why_interesting: The lavalier was reportedly routed UNDER the shirt rather than the normal over-shirt placement — concealing the transmitter from Kirk, security and cameras — and the man in charge of equipment was reportedly the brother-in-law of another staffer.

title: Chest-Shot Witnesses — Planned Narrative?
description: Early on-camera witnesses who described a chest wound that never matched the visible neck injury.
why_interesting: Multiple on-scene speakers told cameras Kirk was hit "right directly to the heart" — chest language repeated across airings that had to be abandoned once neck-wound video circulated; one witness reportedly reversed her account.

title: AES — Accurate Energetic Systems (Company Profile)
description: Profile of the Tennessee explosives manufacturer at the center of the mic theory's supply-chain thread.
why_interesting: AES sits on a ~1,300-acre site in McEwen, Tennessee making shaped charges and demolition charges for DoD — and its federal contract records, pulled from USASpending.gov, include miniature anti-personnel charges.

title: RODE Wireless PRO — The Microphone on Kirk's Shirt
description: Hardware breakdown of the exact lavalier system clipped to Charlie Kirk at UVU.
why_interesting: The RODE Wireless PRO's magnetic clasp is a small black rectangle — the same object video analysts say they can see ejected from Kirk's neck wound in two separate camera angles.

title: Stew Peters — Broke the AES / Exploding-Mic Connection
description: Stew Peters' claim that he first tied the exploding-mic theory to the AES contract and factory blast.
why_interesting: Peters states he broke the story linking a ~$440k DoD order to Accurate Energetic Systems, the plant's later destruction, and claims involving Pete Hegseth's overflight and Elbit Systems of America.

title: Explosive Residue — Transfer, Trapping and Recovery from Fabric
description: The forensic science of why post-blast residue survives on clothing and car carpet long enough to be tested.
why_interesting: One HPLC study recovered RDX at 3-4 micrograms per gram from nylon and cotton — meaning the shirt, the seized clothing and the SUV carpet at UVU were all still testable, and none of it was publicly tested.

title: Transport SUV Not Held in Long-Term Custody
description: Claims that the GMC Yukon that carried Kirk was cleaned and prepped for resale rather than sealed as evidence.
why_interesting: The vehicle that carried a dying Charlie Kirk was reportedly towed, cleaned and readied for resale instead of being held as a sealed forensic surface — while fragment and residue questions about its interior remain open.

title: Ceiling Mudded / Painted Under the Courtyard Building
description: Reported re-mudding or repainting of the concrete tunnel roof beside the UVU tent.
why_interesting: A third surface after soil and pavers: the overhead concrete beside the tent was reportedly mudded or repainted — blast blowback goes up as well as down, and an overhead surface is not something ordinary landscaping touches.

title: Microphone — The Exploding Mic Theory
description: Hub page assembling video, audio, hardware, procurement, debris and veteran-testimony strands of the exploding-mic case.
why_interesting: This hub shows the theory does not rest on one clip: video frame analysis, broadcast audio, a federal micro-charge contract, SUV debris and two combat veterans all converge on the same non-rifle conclusion.

title: High Explosive — RDX, PETN and TNT-Class Compounds
description: Primer on the military explosives that recur in the mic thread and what a tiny charge would leave behind.
why_interesting: PETN — the same compound used in the 2024 Hezbollah pager operation, where concealed micro-charges were remotely detonated inside everyday devices — is the explosive AES Building 602 was reportedly handling.

title: Mic vs Pendant — Competing Internal-Device Theories
description: Head-to-head comparison of the lapel-transmitter and crucifix-pendant explosive theories.
why_interesting: Both competing citizen theories accept the same premise the newcomer has never heard: the device was already ON Charlie Kirk's body. They disagree only about which object it was hidden in.

title: Exploding Earpiece (IEM) — Alternate Internal-Device Theory
description: Unverified citizen theory that the in-ear monitor, not the lapel pack, carried the charge.
why_interesting: This attributed theory puts a tiny low-flash charge in Kirk's in-ear monitor, delivering energy through the ear canal with the IEM wire whipping — and proposes RF initiation over the PA path. Unverified.

title: Demonstration of a Shaped Charge
description: Video of a real shaped charge detonating, circulated by skeptics of the mic theory.
why_interesting: This page carries the strongest counterargument on the site: a real shaped charge produces a large smoke cloud that skeptics say is simply absent from the UVU footage.

title: LiPO Short Charge / Battery Runaway — Non-PETN Mic Failure
description: Alternate theory that the transmitter failed through lithium-polymer thermal runaway rather than a military charge.
why_interesting: An explosive event at the mic need not imply a military micro-charge — this attributed theory has the RODE pack's lithium-polymer cell going into runaway, turning battery and PCB fragments into projectiles.

title: Mic Investigation Index
description: Working memo mapping every strand of the exploding-mic investigation.
why_interesting: A working index showing the mic thread is a coordinated multi-front investigation — video, audio, hardware, procurement, SUV fragments, AV chain of custody — not a single viral claim.

title: Geopolitical and Intelligence-Service Motive Theories (Claims)
description: Catalogs foreign-intelligence motive claims: blocked NCTC probe, Egyptian aircraft at Provo, Fort Huachuca flights, and shaped-charge sophistication arguments.
why_interesting: Reportedly the NCTC foreign-interference probe was "snuffed out"; Russell Brand cited two cabinet-meeting sources saying officials declared six days later they were not looking at foreign involvement or accomplices.

title: Institutional, Media, and Organizational Motive Dynamics (Claims)
description: Documents narrative-control, TPUSA succession, insurance, gag-order, and FARA-filing incentives shaping how the killing was publicly explained.
why_interesting: Brad Parscale's Clock Tower X LLC reportedly filed FARA on Sept 18, 2025 — eight days after the shooting — for Israeli government messaging work routed into Salem Media, TPUSA's existing partner.

title: Motive Investigation Index
description: Routing memo mapping four motive lanes: donor and Israel friction, reported death warnings, geopolitical intel context, and institutional incentives.
why_interesting: Reported texts days before: "I'm worried that Israel is going to kill me" and "THEY ARE GOING TO KILL ME," plus a message to security chief Dan Flood saying he would be killed tomorrow.

title: Tyler Robinson's Alleged Personal and Ideological Motives (As Reported)
description: Presents the prosecution's ideological-grievance motive alongside citizen patsy, courier, and manipulated-participant reinterpretations.
why_interesting: Investigators reportedly cited roughly $20,000 in additional deposits, and researchers note Robinson never confessed — the arrest reportedly traced to his father contacting a "sheriff friend."

title: Motive
description: Section landing page summarizing donor-pressure, geopolitical, institutional, and official motive threads with the "Chain of Evil" video.
why_interesting: Reportedly about 48 hours before UVU, Kirk wrote he had "no choice but to leave the pro Israel cause" — and former NCTC director Joe Kent says on record his foreign-ties review was ordered stopped.

title: Shot in the Heart — Early Claims vs. What Video Shows
description: Catalogs TV and X claims that Kirk was shot in the heart or chest, against footage showing no chest wound.
why_interesting: A TV witness said "one shot, right directly to the heart" and that police had "arrested the wrong guy" — George Zinn; yet no chest hole or chest blood appears in footage, and the heart framing then vanished from broadcasts.

title: Narrative
description: Section hub on how the shooting story was framed in real time and which framings quietly disappeared.
why_interesting: Links the wrong-guy and heart-wound framings to reported narrative-control operations and a claimed "confession" fabrication question — surfacing framings that spread fast on TV then receded once raw video circulated.

title: BeLo Livestream Call — Unfuck America Tour
description: Covers a livestream phone call minutes after the shooting and the Unfuck America Tour website going 404 the same day.
why_interesting: Reportedly the tour's founder called a livestream minutes after the shooting saying "Dude, we're fucked," moved to Discord, and Wayback captures show unfuckamericatour.com 404ing at 19:55:06 on Sept 10, 2025.

title: Organizations & Groups
description: Hub mapping event organizers, security and AV vendors, contractors, agencies, and networks named in the case.
why_interesting: Names concrete vendors rarely reported: Visual Impulse LLC AV techs tied to SD-card-removal timing, Integrity Security Solutions rooftop gaps, and Hardscape Specialties LLC's disputed post-event courtyard re-paving.

title: Forensic Analysis Gaps
description: Catalogs the forensic materials never produced: GSR testing, autopsy, chain of custody, and the paved-over crime scene.
why_interesting: The Sept 17 2025 ATF report reportedly said the autopsy jacket fragment "could not be identified or excluded" as fired from the Mauser; the suspect was reportedly never given a GSR test after a 33-hour manhunt.

title: Miscellaneous Evidence Leads
description: Cross-cutting leads: sealed warrants, Google Trends from foreign IPs, airport badge logs, aircraft times, and diversion-actor claims.
why_interesting: Digital-forensics warrants reportedly sealed until March 2026; commentary cites Israeli and D.C. IP Google Trends for UVU months pre-event, a Provo airport badge list updated Sept 11, and SU-BTT departing 7:08 a.m.

title: Evidence Contradictions in the Kirk Case
description: Maps conflicting official and OSINT accounts of shot time, suspect movement, ballistics, and media handling.
why_interesting: The impact second is disputed 12:23 vs 12:27 PM MDT, a single Dairy Queen photo is annotated both 12:38 PM and 6:38 PM, and rifle claims include a Mauser 98 rather than the stated narrative.

title: Witness Reliability Issues
description: Examines why witness accounts conflict and the alleged handling of witness video, FBI 302s, and camera media.
why_interesting: A back-facing camera's SD card was reportedly removed at the scene rather than the costlier camera body, and agents allegedly asked witnesses to delete their phone video of the shooting.

title: Investigation Challenges
description: Systemic obstacles blocking verification: sealing, gag orders, classification, platform takedowns, and destroyed scene evidence.
why_interesting: Warrants sealed until March 2026, a reported halt of the foreign-lead counterterror review, opaque Army HADES aircraft N1098L activity, and FOIA resistance on SAM jet 99-0404 passenger manifests.

title: Psychological Profiling Claims
description: Reviews profiling narratives about the accused and alternate actors, plus reported statements about Kirk's final weeks.
why_interesting: Kirk reportedly told Megyn Kelly "My integrity is being called into question" and, in messages surfaced by Candace Owens, described donor pressure "leaving me no choice but to leave the pro-Israel cause."

title: Investigation Methodology and Research Approach
description: Explains the OSINT sourcing standards, labeling of fact versus allegation, and obstacles shaping what can be verified.
why_interesting: It records the shooting-time conflict as 12:10 versus 12:23 and states plainly that camera metadata, acoustic lab work, and the autopsy — all withheld — are what would settle it.

title: Public Response and Social Division
description: Documents vigils, firings, visa revocations, censorship of investigators, and the polarized reaction to the killing.
why_interesting: Foreign nationals reportedly faced U.S. visa revocations and deportations for celebratory posts, and the Robinson family reportedly went into hiding with armed security after threats.

title: Other Topics
description: Index hub linking the eight cross-cutting pages on contradictions, forensic gaps, methodology, leads, and public response.
why_interesting: The hub itself names the live cross-cutting disputes: sealed autopsy versus hearing cause-of-death accounts, a second-vehicle SUV hospital claim, and the microphone-versus-rifle mechanism debate.

title: Other Topics
description: Routing page collecting cross-cutting investigation threads that span multiple sections and have no single Level 2 home.
why_interesting: Parks threads like courtyard dirt reportedly removed after scene release, an alleged NCTC foreign-nexus halt, Egyptian-registered aircraft at Provo, and the mic-explosive versus .30-06 dual theory.

title: Tyler Robinson
description: Profile of the charged suspect, opening with the argument that a .30-06 round could not have produced the observed wound.
why_interesting: A .30-06 carries roughly 2,900 ft-lbs, about eight times a 9mm, yet the round reportedly never exited the neck; the ATF comparison to the seized Mauser 98 came back inconclusive.

title: Rob O'Neill
description: The Navy SEAL who killed Osama bin Laden publicly questioning the official shooting narrative on Newsmax.
why_interesting: The SEAL Team 6 operator credited with killing bin Laden said on Newsmax the footage "looks like an explosion to me" and flatly rejected the idea Kirk's spine stopped the round.

title: Blaine Holt
description: Retired U.S. brigadier general who challenged the rifle account on national television.
why_interesting: A retired brigadier general said on Newsmax "something exploded on him" and argued you would not put an untrained kid on a roof with a .30-06.

title: Unnamed Surgeon
description: The never-identified trauma surgeon at Timpanogos Regional Hospital whose account reached the public only secondhand.
why_interesting: The entire "Charlie's body stopped it / bones like the man of steel" story routes through one anonymous doctor and one TPUSA spokesman; no named source exists for it at all.

title: Samantha Karner
description: ATF firearm and toolmark examiner who compared the autopsy bullet jacket fragment to the seized rifle.
why_interesting: The ATF examiner reportedly testified she was "unable to say one way or another" whether the jacket fragment recovered at autopsy came from the Mauser Model 98 tied to Robinson.

title: Dr. Deirdre Amaro
description: Utah's chief medical examiner during the case, her reported resignation, and the contested autopsy record.
why_interesting: Utah's chief medical examiner reportedly resigned in July 2026; at the preliminary hearing her autopsy report came in only through an agent, and the defense objected to it as hearsay.

title: Mystery Woman Who Signed Off (Allegation)
description: An unverified allegation that an unqualified stranger signed off on the Charlie Kirk autopsy report.
why_interesting: A secondhand X claim alleges a "new, young, blonde and clearly unqualified" woman the examiner had never met signed off on the autopsy before it was finished.

title: Chris Bagley
description: Former UVU campus police officer at the center of the body-camera blackout questions, and his resignation.
why_interesting: Officers reportedly call the body-camera blackout implausible, an anonymous Axon Body 4 tip circulated, and Utah statute requires a written report whenever a camera is not activated.

title: Alan Robertson
description: The plain-clothes officer reportedly identified in bystander footage on the Losee Center rooftop.
why_interesting: Candace Owens reportedly identified the second, plain-clothes man on the Losee Center rooftop as a Utah State University public-safety officer with a military and police background.

title: Adam Neff
description: Army captain named in whistleblower-sourced commentary about a Fort Huachuca interrogation the day before the killing.
why_interesting: Whistleblower-sourced commentary amplified by Candace Owens reportedly names him as leading an interrogation at the Army intelligence hub Fort Huachuca on September 9, 2025 — one day before.

title: Mitch Snow
description: The whistleblower behind the Fort Huachuca meeting claims and reported pre-event sightings.
why_interesting: The reported Fort Huachuca thread — an Army intelligence installation meeting the day before the assassination — traces back to this single named whistleblower account.

title: Jack Posobiec
description: Conservative activist with a documented Navy intelligence background and his Fort Huachuca exchange with TPUSA's COO.
why_interesting: A prominent movement figure has a documented U.S. Navy intelligence background, and his widely circulated exchange with TPUSA's Tyler Bowyer turned on Fort Huachuca.

title: Mikey McCoy
description: TPUSA chief of staff standing feet from the stage, and the reconstructed 12:23–12:24 post-shot call chain.
why_interesting: Analysis circulated by @KeliRabon argues he moved away with a phone already at his ear within a split second of the shot, without appearing to render aid.

title: Amanda Bakker
description: FBI DNA examiner from Quantico, reportedly the only FBI person to take the live stand at the preliminary hearing.
why_interesting: Only one FBI employee reportedly testified live at the July 2026 hearing — a DNA examiner called by the defense, who described mixture DNA on the towel and screwdriver.

title: David Hull
description: Utah SBI lead investigator whose two days of testimony carried the surveillance montage, identification, and autopsy foundation.
why_interesting: The state's whole evidentiary spine — surveillance montage, identification, autopsy findings, and the leads investigators discarded — came in through one agent's testimony.

title: Kash Patel
description: FBI Director whose public statements form the federal narrative citizen investigators test against court filings.
why_interesting: The FBI Director's public claims about the 33-hour manhunt, the screwdriver DNA and the enhanced photos are the exact statements that citizen investigators check against the court record.

title: Candace Owens
description: Close friend of Charlie Kirk who became the most prominent independent voice challenging the official account.
why_interesting: One of Kirk's closest friends turned into the loudest mainstream challenger of the official story, breaking the rooftop-officer identification and the medical-examiner resignation report.

title: Ian Carroll
description: The largest single research archive on the site: a thematic map of one investigator's primary-source-dense claims.
why_interesting: An 800-plus-line primary-source archive maps foreign-intelligence, financial and network claims about the case that no mainstream outlet has aggregated in one place.

title: Chris Martenson
description: Peak Prosperity analyst whose ballistics breakdown argues the wound fits a different round entirely.
why_interesting: A credentialed analyst's public breakdown concludes the wound pattern does not fit the officially named cartridge and points to a different round.

title: Matthew St Baker
description: Citizen investigator who amplified the shaped-charge "exploding pendant" theory of Charlie Kirk's death.
why_interesting: He reshared the theory that a shaped charge worn as a pendant, not a rifle round, caused the neck wound — the explosive hypothesis in its most specific form.

title: Tiffany Barker
description: Early on-scene witness whose first account to media conflicts with the official wound location.
why_interesting: An early witness told media Charlie Kirk was shot in the chest — not the neck — before the official account settled.

title: Andrew Kolvet
description: TPUSA's spokesman and the sole conduit for the anonymous surgeon's account of the wound.
why_interesting: Every version of the "bullet should have gone through" story reaches the public through this one spokesman relaying an unnamed doctor he says he spoke with.

title: Blake Neff
description: Producer of The Charlie Kirk Show and his disputed post-shooting phone call.
why_interesting: Per Candace Owens he called his mother in the minutes after the shooting; he has publicly responded to her accusations rather than let them stand.

title: Justin Streiff
description: TPUSA operations figure, a contested phone-call claim, and the September 2 memo preceding a COO change.
why_interesting: A September 2, 2025 memo, a change in TPUSA's COO role, and a DOGE-audit thread all cluster in the eight days before the assassination.

title: Dan Flood
description: Security figure reported to have received a threat text ahead of the September 10 event.
why_interesting: A security director is reported to have received a threatening text before the event — a warning the official narrative does not account for.

title: Jeffrey S. Gray
description: Utah County Attorney prosecuting the case, and questions raised over rooftop-view video files.
why_interesting: Online commentary questions his office's handling of the video files showing the rooftop view — the footage most directly bearing on the shot's origin.

title: Jeffrey Neiman
description: Attorney for the Kirk family who pushed for evidence to be shown publicly and unredacted.
why_interesting: The Kirk family's own lawyer had to press the court for public, unredacted display of preliminary-hearing evidence — the family fighting redaction, not the defense.

title: Lance Twiggs
description: The roommate at the center of the state's motive story, and the citizen-investigator threads around that account.
why_interesting: The roommate whose messages anchor the state's motive theory is himself the subject of extensive open questions about who he is and how his account surfaced.

title: Hunter Kozak
description: The student who asked Charlie Kirk the final question, and the two differing clips of that moment.
why_interesting: Two versions of the final-question clip are reportedly circulating online that do not match — an unresolved discrepancy in the most-watched seconds of the event.

title: Jeb Jacobi
description: Eyewitness roughly ten feet away, and the open question of whether he is the same person as "Cooper Brown".
why_interesting: A witness standing about ten feet from Kirk may be the same individual media introduced under a different name, "Cooper Brown" — an unresolved identity question.

title: Jason Behunin
description: Witness whose account touches the aftermath and a discussion of a cleanup crew at the scene.
why_interesting: His account reaches into what happened after the shot, including discussion of a cleanup crew at a scene that should have been preserved as evidence.

title: Tony Seruga
description: Investigator arguing the NSA's Utah data center could identify foreign phones near the scene.
why_interesting: He asserts the NSA's Utah data center, minutes from the campus, already holds the records that would tie foreign phones near the scene back to their owners.

title: Steven DeNoon
description: Self-described ex-CIA YouTube commentator amplifying laser, ballistics, and "tent shooter" theories.
why_interesting: A self-described former CIA man publicly argues the shot came from inside the tent, not the distant rooftop the state describes.

title: Yair Netanyahu
description: The Israeli prime minister's son named in unverified commentary about 2025 pre-event meetings.
why_interesting: Commentary places the Israeli prime minister's son in pre-event meeting threads during 2025; the presence claims are unverified and disputed.

title: Natasha Hausdorff
description: UK lawyer and pro-Israel advocate named in reporting about a summer 2025 Hamptons meeting with Charlie Kirk.
why_interesting: A reported summer 2025 Hamptons meeting placed Kirk with a prominent pro-Israel legal advocate weeks before he was killed, according to public commentary.

title: Yehuda Kaploun
description: Figure named in commentary about a reported July 31, 2025 White House Israel strategy meeting.
why_interesting: Commentary reports a White House Israel strategy meeting on July 31, 2025 — roughly six weeks before the assassination — with named attendees.

title: Robert Shillman
description: Major conservative donor reported to have cut ties with Charlie Kirk over his shifting Israel rhetoric.
why_interesting: A major donor is reported to have cut ties with Kirk shortly before his death over Kirk's changing public line on Israel.

title: Bradley Hansell
description: The Under Secretary of Defense for Intelligence, his public office and résumé.
why_interesting: The Pentagon's top intelligence official; the page records his public office and résumé.

title: John Kiriakou
description: Former CIA officer and whistleblower cited on MK-Ultra hypnosis in the mind-control framing of the case.
why_interesting: A former CIA officer who went to prison as a whistleblower describes MK-Ultra hypnosis on the record, the program that frames the patsy question here.

title: Jennifer Faumuina
description: SBI sergeant who testified on rifle recovery, evidence routing, engraved rounds, and Dremel evidence.
why_interesting: Her testimony covers engraved cartridges and a Dremel tool, and the chain by which the towel and screwdriver were routed to the labs.

title: The Microphone — Photo 34
description: A forensic-style table scoring each case finding against two competing hypotheses: a .30-06 rifle versus a shaped charge.
why_interesting: A scored comparison table pits 'RIFLE (.30-06)' against 'SHAPED CHARGE' row by row — 53 Hz cavity-mode peak, +14.1 dB energy ratio, 104-microsecond rise time — with a per-row delta favoring the charge.

title: Blast Velocity Calculation for the Proposed Charge
description: A thread's closing arithmetic modeling what a small PETN shaped charge would sound like and what wound it would leave.
why_interesting: The calculation argues a small PETN charge would sound like a gunshot yet, lacking rifling, decay to ~309 m/s — strong enough to cause the wound but incapable of an exit wound, matching the reported no-exit finding.

title: DoD Purchase Order to Accurate Energetic Systems
description: A USAspending.gov record of a Department of Defense purchase order to a Tennessee explosives maker for miniaturized demolition charges.
why_interesting: A public federal record: DoD purchase order N0016425PJ538, $440,494, to Accurate Energetic Systems for 'MINIATURIZED-S DEMOLITION CHARGES' — running May 1 to August 25, 2025, sixteen days before the assassination.

title: Before and After Aerial Comparison of the AES Building
description: Before-and-after aerial imagery of the Accurate Energetic Systems explosives building in rural Tennessee.
why_interesting: The same Tennessee plant that held the miniaturized-demolition-charge contract was later reduced to a debris field — the building simply gone from the after image, the access road still traceable through rubble.

title: The Assembled Custody Timeline
description: An assembled custody timeline drawn from court filings and public records covering September 11 and 12, 2025.
why_interesting: Miranda rights are logged at 6:25 PM on September 11 per exhibit Bates 003996-R2 — hours before the Discord messages appear at ~7:57 PM and before the sheriff's reported 8:02 PM tip call.

title: Court Filing: The 6:25 PM Miranda Transcript
description: A court filing page reproducing a Bates-stamped interview video transcript with a 06:25 PM Miranda reading highlighted.
why_interesting: The filing shows a timestamp but no date; attorney Baron Coleman argues it must be September 11 because the transcript says the lawyer's office is closed 'for the night,' not the weekend — the 12th was Friday.

title: Filing Page 70 — Rights Invoked, Statements Contradicted
description: Page 70 of a court filing arguing the defendant invoked his Fifth and Sixth Amendment rights during the recorded encounter.
why_interesting: A filing made in court, not an online claim, argues Tyler Robinson invoked silence and counsel one minute after the 6:25 PM warning — and that officials' later public statements do not match the recording.

title: Daily Mail: Foreign Intelligence Probe Shut Down
description: A Daily Mail article screenshot reporting that the FBI director ended a foreign-intelligence inquiry into the Kirk case.
why_interesting: Reporting says an inquiry run out of the National Counterterrorism Center by Joe Kent into a possible foreign connection to the killing was shut down by the FBI director amid an interagency feud.

title: Post: C2 Entry Called Mathematically Impossible
description: An X thread arguing the reported C2 neck entry point cannot be reconciled with the rooftop firing angle.
why_interesting: The post argues the round entered at C2 and lodged at T1 — but at the claimed roof height and range, a ten-degree downward path should have entered near C7, calling C2 mathematically impossible.

title: Charred Debris Compared to a Beltpack Transmitter
description: An annotated comparison arguing charred debris recovered from the transport SUV matches a body-worn wireless transmitter.
why_interesting: Numbered callouts on the charred mass label a microphone jack port, an intact casing edge, charred batteries and an antenna base — matched against a Sennheiser ew500 G4 beltpack transmitter.

title: FlightAware: El Paso to Kalispell, 4,700 Feet
description: A FlightAware capture for N1098L on September 10, 2025 annotated with its lowest recorded altitude over Utah Valley.
why_interesting: The Global 6500 flew Fort Bliss to Kalispell and was annotated at 4,700 ft ASL at 9:16 MDT — a few hundred feet above a valley floor near 4,500 feet, extraordinarily low for a transit flight.

title: Second Outlet Reports Army Drone-Launch Tests
description: An aviation-news article reporting the U.S. Army is considering drone launches from a special-mission Bombardier Global 6500.
why_interesting: A second outlet reports the Army weighed drone-launch tests from the Global 6500-based HADES platform — the same airframe type as N1098L — after the primary War Zone source URL reportedly stopped resolving.

title: N888KG Record: No Flights Found
description: A Flightradar24 record for N888KG showing full aircraft specifications but an empty flight history.
why_interesting: The tail number carries an FAA data-limiting flag — 'not available for public tracking per request from the owner/operator' — so mainstream trackers show nothing, while ADS-B Exchange reportedly shows the September 10 track.

title: GRAMA Response Citing the Life or Safety Exemption
description: A public-records response withholding documents about the UVU Fountain Courtyard under a life-or-safety exemption.
why_interesting: Records on approvals for work in the Fountain Courtyard — excavated and repaved four days after the shooting — were withheld under a Utah exemption for disclosures that could 'jeopardize the life or safety of an individual.'

title: 2019 UVU Lecture Page Now Returns 404
description: A 2019 UVU National Security Society event post paired with the university page that now returns a 404 error.
why_interesting: UVU advertised 'The Ethics of CIA Detention and Drone Operations' by a former CIA officer on September 10, 2019 — six years to the day before the assassination — and a related university page no longer resolves.

title: Judge Lunnen's Archived Official Biography
description: The archived Utah Courts biography of Judge Robert C. Lunnen, recording his career before the bench.
why_interesting: The official biography records 21 years as a Department of Justice attorney, Criminal Chief of the U.S. Attorney's Office for Utah, and two details as Judicial Attaché — postings reported at Bogota and Kabul.

title: Search Warrant Affidavit: Seized Electronics
description: A Fourth District Court search warrant affidavit page itemizing eight seized electronic devices with serial numbers.
why_interesting: An itemized State Bureau of Investigation seizure list sharpens a contradiction: prosecutors stated in a filing they did not intend to offer forensic-extraction material, yet the public narrative rests on extracted messages.

title: Modeled Blast Injury Chart for a 2g RDX Charge
description: An engineering-style chart modeling injuries from a 2g RDX shaped charge detonated 2cm from the upper chest.
why_interesting: The model puts a Mach 8, roughly 2,700 m/s shockwave at 160 psi overpressure against the right upper chest, rating severe neurologic injury, pulmonary hemorrhage and cardiac contusion all at extreme risk.

title: Auto-Auction Photo of the Burnt Object as a Screenshot
description: The source photograph of a burnt object on the transport SUV's upholstery, reportedly taken at an auto auction.
why_interesting: The photo underpinning the burnt-transmitter claim was reportedly taken while the vehicle sat at an auto auction — implying the SUV that carried Charlie Kirk was resold and publicly photographed rather than held as evidence.

title: AI Summary of the Official Autopsy and Wound Account
description: An AI assistant's summary of the official cause of death, the recovered bullet and the status of the autopsy report.
why_interesting: The official account itself says the bullet was recovered lodged in the neck with no exit wound — and that the full autopsy report remains confidential, never publicly released.

title: Full-Length Donor Thread with the Counterparty Reply
description: A screenshot of circulated text messages attributed to Charlie Kirk about losing a major donor over Tucker Carlson.
why_interesting: The messages, if authentic, have Kirk writing he 'just lost another huge Jewish donor, $2 million a year' for refusing to cancel Tucker Carlson, and saying he may leave the pro-Israel cause.

title: Report: Salt Lake City FBI Chief Forced Out
description: An MSNBC report that the FBI's Salt Lake City special agent in charge was forced out months before September 2025.
why_interesting: A decorated counterterrorism agent appointed in February to run the Salt Lake City field office was reportedly pushed out six months later, told she was 'not a good fit' — before the assassination in that district.

title: Candace Owens on RCH 702, With the DVIDS Source
description: A composite pairing a Candace Owens post identifying flight RCH 702 with the official DVIDS source photograph.
why_interesting: Owens ties July 11 — the day she says Kirk told Tucker Carlson to 'GO MAX' against Israel — to the announcement of a new CIA executive director, with the DVIDS page shown as the sourcing check.

title: Claim Graphic: The .30-06 Wound Argument
description: A circulated claim graphic arguing the video shows no blood or bullet hole 21 seconds after the shot.
why_interesting: The graphic argues a .30-06 fired from the front would have produced massive bleeding and a visible hole, and that video 21 seconds after the shot shows neither — so the rifle was not the weapon.

title: Reference: Rifle Wound Size on Game Animals
description: A hunting reference photograph circulated to illustrate the wound a .30-06 round produces on comparable body mass.
why_interesting: A .30-06 carries roughly 3,950 joules at the muzzle; the photo of two harvested deer is used to ask why this case's described injury looks nothing like what that energy does.

title: CornerShot Comparison and Shell Casing Annotation
description: A researcher composite pairing an annotated shell-casing close-up with promotional artwork for a CornerShot weapon system.
why_interesting: Researchers annotate a cartridge case they say was ejected at close range near the rear of the canopy — labelled 'SHOT CAME FROM HERE' — and pair it with a hinged corner-firing weapon.

title: Judicial Vacancy Announcement, January 2025
description: Utah's official January 2025 announcement of a Fourth District Court judicial vacancy created by Judge Lunnen's retirement.
why_interesting: The state posted the Fourth District vacancy in January 2025 for Judge Lunnen's retirement effective August 1, 2025 — five weeks before the assassination that would be prosecuted in that court.

title: Tucker Carlson Quote on Blackmail and Officials
description: A screenshot of a post quoting Tucker Carlson describing a conversation with a senior elected official about blackmail.
why_interesting: Carlson describes telling a very senior elected official that officials 'are being blackmailed by the intel agencies,' and quotes the reply verbatim: 'I know.'

title: Thread Author Statement of Explosives Background
description: The opening of an explosives thread in which the author states his claimed military demolitions background.
why_interesting: The author of the shaped-charge thread says he served as a USMC explosive breacher and assault section leader specializing in urban mobility charges — a self-reported, unverified credential the argument rests on.

title: Anchored Charge and Silver Chain Reasoning
description: A thread section arguing a worn silver chain could anchor a cone-shaped charge via the Monroe effect.
why_interesting: The argument is that a neck chain would hold a cone-shaped charge in place and orient it — the Monroe effect — so a tiny worn device could direct blast inward rather than scattering it.

title: The Hansell Helicopter Photograph
description: The official DVIDS photograph of Under Secretary Bradley Hansell visiting Joint Task Force leaders in a helicopter cabin.
why_interesting: An official U.S. government release, not a citizen graphic: it places the Under Secretary for Intelligence and Security with JTF-SB.

title: SU-BND Detail Panel at Provo
description: A Flightradar24 detail panel for Egyptian-registered Gulfstream SU-BND parked at Provo Airport.
why_interesting: An Egypt-registered Gulfstream 4SP, serial 1332, sat on the ground at Provo — listed as 'Private owner' while related SU-BTT is listed as Egypt Government, a classification discrepancy nobody has explained.

title: Facial Radius Analysis at 120 Degrees
description: An independent analyst's reconstruction expressing the impact point as a 120-degree bearing on the facial radius.
why_interesting: The reconstruction treats the head as a sphere and converts impact point into a bearing — 120 degrees here, 157 on companion sheets — to derive a direction of fire testable against the rooftop position.

title: Facebook Profile Listing CIA and Fort Bragg
description: A public Facebook profile whose Details section lists prior work at the CIA and at Fort Bragg.
why_interesting: A publicly visible profile saved by researchers lists 'Worked at Central Intelligence Agency (CIA)', 'Worked at Ft. Bragg, N.C' and 'Former Infantry/Military Intelligence' — though the page calls the connection indirect.

title: How One Video Becomes Two Clips — Discovery Diagram
description: A diagram showing how one source recording can be produced in discovery as two differently edited clips.
why_interesting: Exhibit Bates 003996-R2 carries an 'R2' suffix, indicating a second version of the same exhibit — so prosecution and defense can quote one recording with different cut points and different apparent timings.

title: N1098L Leg List for September 9 and 10
description: A Flightradar24 flight list for N1098L under callsign AXEL10 covering September 9 and 10, 2025.
why_interesting: The tracked legs under callsign AXEL10 run El Paso, Kalispell, Lake Havasu City and Salinas across the two days spanning the assassination — a specific, checkable itinerary for that aircraft.

title: N1098L Aircraft Record on Flightradar24
description: The Flightradar24 aircraft record identifying N1098L by type, serial number and Mode S code.
why_interesting: N1098L is a Bombardier Global 6500, serial 60098, Mode S code A0299E — the same airframe type the U.S. Army uses for its HADES intelligence-surveillance platform.

title: Booking Sheet Highlighted — Arrest Date Sept 11
description: The Utah County booking sheet and probable cause statement with the arrest-date fields highlighted.
why_interesting: The booking paperwork records the arrest on September 11 at 10:00 PM, while the charge sheets are all dated September 12 — a documentary gap in the official account of when custody began.

title: Camera Positions Around the UVU Courtyard
description: An annotated aerial of the UVU courtyard naming every known filmer and each fixed camera position covering the tent.
why_interesting: The annotation maps how many independent cameras and mounted campus domes were pointed at the tent that day — framing the question of how little of that footage has been publicly released.

title: SU-BTT Israel/Egyptian Jet
description: Egyptian Falcon 7X parked at Provo Sept 4-10, 2025, departing the US in the hours around the assassination.
why_interesting: Researchers say the "yellow plane" powered up at 9:05 AM, went dark, reactivated 17 minutes after the shot, and one thread claims it actually lifted off from Dugway Proving Ground with transponder off.

title: N1098L Spy Plane
description: US Army-contracted Bombardier Global 6500 HADES surveillance jet that flew low, slow passes near UVU on September 10, 2025.
why_interesting: An Army ISR jet reportedly descended to roughly 204-335 feet above ground at 118-129 knots within 1-2 miles of campus about 20-25 minutes after the shot; one investigator times the dive at 30 seconds after.

title: SU-BND Blue Plane
description: Egyptian Gulfstream parked at Provo for nearly four months in 2025, transponder powered but not airborne at the key moment.
why_interesting: According to circulating notes the "blue plane" sat at Provo for months with its transponder switched ON but never took off at the moment of the assassination; a viral screenshot claims it pinged only three times, matching three arrivals.

title: N888KG Provo Vanish
description: Challenger 300 that left Provo about an hour after the shooting, lost ADS-B mid-flight, then returned.
why_interesting: Its transponder reportedly went dark near the Arizona border for 30-50+ minutes with no filed flight plan — enough range for a 350-400 nautical mile drop-off — before it reappeared and flew back to Provo.

title: Israel Planes
description: Hub page for the claim that the Egyptian-registered jets tracked near Charlie Kirk secretly flew in and out of Israel.
why_interesting: Trackers allege the jets logged "Cairo-to-Cairo" legs because they switched transponders off and landed in Israel; one unverified eyewitness account places the head of Egyptian intelligence arriving in Israel after such a blackout.

title: Planes Following Charlie or Erika
description: The shadowing claim: foreign government jets and other tails allegedly overlapping the Kirks' travel across TPUSA events for years.
why_interesting: Researchers tally reported overlaps between two Egyptian-registered jets and Erika Kirk's locations 73 times between 2022 and September 2025, with SU-BTT landing at Provo six days before the assassination.

title: N59906 MARC Survey Plane
description: Piper Navajo Chieftain aerial-mapping aircraft reported making four survey passes over UVU the morning of the shooting.
why_interesting: A LiDAR/camera-equipped survey plane reportedly flew four mapping passes over the campus that morning, the last ending about 11:35 a.m. — roughly 15 minutes before the alleged shooter was first seen on campus cameras.

title: Erika Flight Logs Erased
description: A checkable dispute over the removal of N102DZ's public flight history after Erika Kirk invited scrutiny of it.
why_interesting: Erika Kirk publicly told people to check N102DZ's flight logs; researchers say the tail's public history was then removed from FlightRadar24 in May 2026, though copies taken beforehand reportedly still exist.

title: September 10 Flight Timeline
description: Minute-by-minute aircraft and airport timeline for the day of the assassination.
why_interesting: Laid side by side, the transponder-dark window of the Egyptian jet, the N1098L low passes and the hospital timing produce conflicts that the official account does not address.

title: SAM 99-0404 Flight
description: Air Force C-37A VIP Gulfstream tracked into Fort Huachuca, Arizona on September 8-9, 2025.
why_interesting: A government VIP jet reportedly flew into the Army's intelligence and drone-operations base at Fort Huachuca two days before the shooting — the same base other flagged tails in this case are linked to.

title: Utah Cox Foreign Meetings (Claims)
description: Claims that Utah's governor met Egyptian and French diplomatic and intelligence figures at the Capitol 13 days after the assassination.
why_interesting: Reportedly closed-door Gold Room meetings with Egyptian and French officials on September 23, 2025 — 13 days after the killing — while Egyptian-registered jets were the central subject of citizen flight tracking.

title: Egyptian Crew Hotel (Claims)
description: Tip that crews from the Egyptian government jets lodged in Orem from September 4 to 13, 2025.
why_interesting: The claim names a specific hotel on University Parkway in Orem, minutes from campus, as the lodging for the Egyptian jets' occupants across the exact Sept 4-13 window — a concrete FOIA and camera-footage target.

title: N2100L LASAI Sister Ship
description: The second Leidos-linked Global 6500 in the same ISR fleet as N1098L, flagged for activity the night after the shooting.
why_interesting: The spy plane over Orem was not alone — a sister airframe in the same contractor fleet was reportedly active the night after the shooting, meaning two Army ISR jets sit in the case timeline.

title: SU-BTU Israel/Egyptian Jet
description: Third Egyptian-registered Falcon 7X in the alleged five-plane armada cycling through Provo in 2025.
why_interesting: This is not one stray foreign jet: researchers count a whole cluster of Egyptian government Falcons and Gulfstreams rotating through a small Utah municipal airport across 2025.

title: SU-BTV Israel/Egyptian Jet
description: Fourth Egyptian-registered VIP jet in the armada reported operating in and out of Provo, Utah in 2025.
why_interesting: A fourth foreign government VIP jet on the Provo ramp in the same year — a level of foreign state aviation traffic a small Utah airport has no ordinary reason to see.

title: SU-BGM Israel/Egyptian Jet
description: Fifth tail in the alleged Egyptian jet armada, a Gulfstream IV cycling through Provo in 2025.
why_interesting: The fifth Egyptian-registered tail completes the set trackers call an "armada" — five foreign state aircraft, one small airport, the year of the assassination.

title: N560TW Scottsdale Jet
description: Citation XLS that flew Scottsdale-Provo-Santa Barbara on the morning of September 10, 2025.
why_interesting: Candace Owens publicly flagged this short out-and-back through Provo hours before the shooting; the aircraft is reported to be tied to a Turning Point USA donor aviation entity.

title: N582MM TPUSA Aircraft
description: Aircraft described as frequently used by TPUSA insiders and named in the proposed disclosure laws.
why_interesting: Named in draft federal disclosure legislation over a reported October 2025 movement from Fort Huachuca — the Army intelligence base — to Kalispell, Montana.

title: SAM702 Flight
description: Primary Special Air Mission callsign for the VIP flight tied to the September 8-9, 2025 Fort Huachuca window.
why_interesting: The callsign links a Cabinet-level VIP transport to Fort Huachuca 48 hours before the assassination, a coincidence heavily pressed on Candace Owens' podcast.

title: N102DZ Kirk's Plane
description: The jet reported to have flown Charlie Kirk from Scottsdale into Salt Lake City the morning of September 10, 2025.
why_interesting: This is the tail whose public tracking history researchers say later vanished from FlightRadar24 — the very logs Erika Kirk had invited the public to examine.

title: ISR Program Context
description: Explains the US Army HADES / LASAI Global 6500 surveillance program behind N1098L and N2100L.
why_interesting: N1098L shares the Global 6500 airframe the Army uses for HADES, but it very likely was a training plane not built out to launch drones — which makes who scheduled it over Orem that day the question worth investigating.

title: T7ELL & EJM36 (Flagged Tails)
description: Two further foreign-registered tails flagged alongside the Egyptian armada in flight-log research.
why_interesting: Both tails are written into proposed federal disclosure legislation, meaning citizen flight-log research has already crossed into draft law text.

title: N55906
description: An unresolved tail number circulated in open-source flight threads, with no confirmed type, operator or route in the public record.
why_interesting: The tail has no confirmed route, operator or ADS-B track anywhere in the public record, and differs from the documented survey aircraft N59906 by a single digit — the most likely resolution is that it was a misreading all along.

title: Air Force Two Casket Flight
description: Air Force Two carried Charlie Kirk's casket from Salt Lake City to Phoenix on September 11, 2025.
why_interesting: A sitting Vice President personally accompanied the remains on the government's own VIP aircraft the day after the killing — an extraordinary level of federal involvement for a private citizen.

title: 99-0004 Vance Flight
description: Air Force C-32A tracked to Las Vegas on May 27, 2025 under callsign SAM912.
why_interesting: The same C-32A airframe type flagged on a Las Vegas run three and a half months before the assassination reappears the day after it, carrying the casket.

title: SAM-000 Flight
description: One of several Special Air Mission callsigns reported for the VIP aircraft tail 99-0404.
why_interesting: The same physical VIP jet appears in public tracking under several rotating callsigns, which is how a single airframe can seem to be several flights.

title: SAM-112 Flight
description: Another Special Air Mission callsign reported for the VIP flight tail 99-0404.
why_interesting: Callsign switching on the same tail number complicates any attempt to reconstruct where this government aircraft actually went in early September 2025.

title: SAM650 Flight
description: VIP callsign appearing in citizen tracking of government routes in the days before the assassination.
why_interesting: Citizen trackers logged this callsign hitting Joint Base Andrews, Nashville and Colorado Springs in the run-up to September 10, 2025.

title: N40JD Provo Arrival
description: Beechcraft Premier 1 recorded flying Scottsdale to Provo on September 10, 2025.
why_interesting: Provo's small municipal field logged an unusual cluster of private arrivals on the morning of the shooting, and this Scottsdale leg is one of them.

title: N872RA Provo Arrival
description: Hawker Beechcraft reported flying Santa Barbara into Provo on September 10, 2025.
why_interesting: Another private jet in the same-day Provo arrival cluster, on the Santa Barbara route also flown by the Candace Owens-flagged N560TW.

title: Biggs Army Airfield (KBIF)
description: The Fort Bliss army airfield from which the ISR jet N1098L departed on the morning of the shooting.
why_interesting: The spy plane that made the low passes near UVU launched that morning from an Army airfield at Fort Bliss, Texas — a military origin, not a civilian one.

title: Roland R. Wright Air National Guard Base
description: The Utah Air National Guard base where Air Force Two landed to receive the casket on September 11, 2025.
why_interesting: The transfer of the remains happened on a military installation rather than a civilian terminal, keeping the September 11 movement inside government-controlled ground.

title: Joint Base Andrews (KADW)
description: Home of the 89th Airlift Wing and origin point for both government VIP aircraft in the case.
why_interesting: Both VIP flights in this investigation — the pre-event Fort Huachuca run and the post-event casket transport — trace back to the same single base.

title: Pilatus PC-12 (Unconfirmed)
description: A low-confidence, uncorroborated report of a PC-12 circling near UVU around September 10, 2025.
why_interesting: Catalogued explicitly as unverified with no tail number and no flight track — an example of the site recording a claim in order to caveat it rather than repeat it.

title: Planes Investigation Index
description: Working memo listing every open aircraft thread and the records that would settle each one.
why_interesting: It names exactly which records — MARC survey logs, ADS-B raw feeds, tasking orders — would resolve each aircraft question, turning suspicion into a concrete disclosure demand list.

title: Planes
description: Index of every aircraft and flight-path topic tied to the September 10, 2025 assassination.
why_interesting: The sheer size of the catalog is itself the point: dozens of separate tail numbers, foreign government jets and military ISR platforms all converge on one small Utah valley in one week.

title: Political Context
description: Maps donor, Israel-related, and TPUSA pressure narratives surrounding Charlie Kirk in the months before September 10, 2025.
why_interesting: Reportedly leaked TPUSA texts describe Kirk, days before his death, angry over a large donor loss tied to platforming Tucker Carlson and talking about leaving the "pro-Israel cause"; Joe Kent says a foreign-nexus review was ordered abandoned.

title: Joe Kent — Foreign Inquiry Shutdown
description: NCTC director Joe Kent says the FBI halted his inquiry into foreign involvement in Charlie Kirk's death.
why_interesting: A sitting U.S. intelligence director says on record the FBI stopped his foreign-nexus probe; officials reportedly feared it would let Robinson's defense argue more than one suspect.

title: N1098L HADES Over UVU
description: Army HADES ISR jet N1098L flew low, slow passes near UVU before and after the shooting on Sept 10.
why_interesting: A U.S. Army spy jet, callsign AXEL10, reportedly dropped to ~204 ft at near-stall 116 knots about a mile from campus 25 minutes after the shot. No Army mission explanation exists.

title: Israeli Phones & Bumblehive
description: NSA Utah Data Center claims of Israeli and foreign handsets at UVU during the shooting, later traced abroad.
why_interesting: Tony Seruga reportedly claims 16 Israeli plus 44 foreign phones sat beside Charlie Kirk at the moment of death — and four later surfaced at Islamabad's Serena Hotel during Iran talks.

title: UVU Sept 9 Foreknowledge
description: GRAMA-released UVU records showing two separate warnings the night before the assassination, names redacted.
why_interesting: Released UVU chat logs show people came to campus police the night before about 'a plan,' and a redacted email asking to 'get a message to Charlie Kirk.' Nobody documented either.

title: Egyptian Jets — Provo Sept 4–10
description: Egyptian government aircraft SU-BTT tracked on the ground at Provo the week Charlie Kirk was killed.
why_interesting: An Egyptian government Falcon 7X reportedly flew Paris to Minot to Provo six days before the killing and departed Utah about five hours before the assassination.

title: Provo Airport Counter-UAS
description: Alleged Egyptian-linked contractors testing anti-drone gear at Provo airport Sept 4–10 with DoD liaison badges.
why_interesting: Unnamed Duncan Aviation sources allege men with Egyptian passports carried 'U.S. Department of Defense Liaison' badges and entered on a 'no-scan priority clearance' with no manifest recorded.

title: Fort Huachuca — Sept 9 Meeting
description: Alleged Army intelligence gathering and SAM-702 VIP flight from Fort Huachuca two days before the killing.
why_interesting: Roughly 12 lieutenant colonels reportedly met at the Army's intelligence school, and a VIP jet left at 00:49 on Sept 9 — personnel then reportedly went to Biggs, where N1098L departed.

title: FBI Intel Cover Signatures
description: Catalog of federal behaviors after the shooting cited as intelligence-style cover and scene control.
why_interesting: Researchers allege searches failed repeatedly until three federal agents directed three junior officers to look again — and that bomb dogs were reportedly kept away from certain areas.

title: State Actors & Professional Hit
description: Benny Johnson's on-camera 'state actors' remark and the professional-hit pattern checklist built around it.
why_interesting: A commentator close to Kirk's team says on video there is 'considerable evidence that there were state actors involved' — then stops, saying he cannot go further.

title: Foreign Weapons & Hardware
description: Claims of non-retail hardware — CornerShot mounts, shaped charges, drones — instead of a bolt-action rifle.
why_interesting: Analysts reportedly argue a CornerShot rig fired 9mm from inside the tent, a casing rolled down the tarp, and the energy dump is inconsistent with a distant .30-06.

title: Israel Motive Timeline
description: September 2025 timeline of Kirk's reported break with pro-Israel donors in the days before he was killed.
why_interesting: Kirk reportedly told a group chat he had 'no choice but to leave pro Israel cause,' criticized Israel to Ben Shapiro's face on Sept 9, and was killed the next day.

title: Proof Intel Services — Investigation Index
description: Working memo indexing every intelligence-connection thread with a consolidated key-dates list and disclosure targets.
why_interesting: Its one-screen date table stacks the Egyptian jet's 7:08 departure, the 9:16 AM and 12:48 PM spy-jet passes, and the 12:23 PM shooting into a single sequence.

title: Proof Intel Services
description: Section landing page mapping U.S. and foreign intelligence indicators around UVU on September 10, 2025.
why_interesting: Summarizes that a halted federal foreign probe, foreign handsets at the courtyard, an Army jet at 204 feet, and a parked foreign government jet all occurred in one week.

title: ATF Inconclusive Ballistics
description: The state's own ATF lab could not match the autopsy bullet jacket fragment to the rifle attributed to Tyler Robinson.
why_interesting: A September 17, 2025 ATF report summarized in court filings reportedly could neither identify nor exclude the recovered Mauser as the source of autopsy Exhibit 6A — rifling matched "numerous makes and models."

title: Acoustic Two-Event Split
description: Canon XA55 broadcast audio analysis reportedly shows two separate acoustic events at different distances, not one rifle shot.
why_interesting: Citizen analysis of uncompressed 48kHz Canon XA55 audio reportedly finds a distant muzzle blast at +202ms and a LOUDER low-frequency peak at +321ms located at the tent ~46m away.

title: Discord & Custody Timeline
description: Timing conflict between reported 6:25 PM custody and phone seizure and Discord confession posts timestamped 7:57 PM.
why_interesting: Robinson was reportedly mirandized in Washington County custody around 6:25 PM Sept 11 — with phone seized by protocol — yet the "confession" Discord traffic is timestamped 7:57 PM, about 90 minutes later.

title: Trajectory & Wound Mismatch
description: Rooftop geometry and the reported neck wound morphology are argued not to fit a distant .30-06 rifle strike.
why_interesting: A 5-9 degree downward path from 120m east should hit face or jaw, yet entry was reportedly between larynx and trachea — and a treating doctor reportedly said the bullet "did not exit."

title: Gun Discovery Sequence
description: Reported sequence in which arm-to-arm and K-9 searches found no weapon until federal agents redirected junior officers.
why_interesting: Per the master file, local arm-to-arm sweeps and a K-9 pass reportedly found nothing; only after three federal agents told three junior new-hire local officers to search again did the towel-wrapped Mauser appear.

title: Stairs Guy Identity Gap
description: Video-comparison mismatches between campus Tyler and the stairs/rooftop figure in backpack, hat, and clothing.
why_interesting: Campus Tyler wore light shorts with a half-full light blue pack; the stairs figure wears dark jeans with a pack 90-95% full — fuller after an alleged rifle was deployed. A filmmaker witness reportedly said "Tyler Robinson is NOT the guy."

title: No GSR & Missing Physical Tests
description: Reported absence of standard gunshot-residue testing plus a complex multi-source DNA mixture on the recovered rifle.
why_interesting: Citizen compilations allege Robinson was never given a standard gunshot-residue test in a capital case, and court summaries describe multiple DNA profiles on the Mauser rather than a single-source match.

title: Witness & Audio Conflicts
description: Ear-witnesses describing pistol or firework sounds, a false all-clear alert, and eyewitness photo mismatches.
why_interesting: A UVU witness interviewed on X says he could find nobody describing a large-calibre rifle — only pops and pistol sounds — and a campus alert 19 minutes after the shooting wrongly told ~10,000 students the suspect was in custody.

title: Backpack & Rifle Impossibility
description: Physical argument that a scoped Mauser .30-06 could not be concealed in the clothing and pack seen on camera.
why_interesting: Morning footage reportedly shows light shorts and a roughly half-empty pack — no space or pant leg for a scoped Mauser — while the rooftop figure's pack looks fuller, the opposite of what stowing a rifle would produce.

title: Alternative Kill Mechanisms
description: Routing page for non-rifle hypotheses including a rigged lapel mic charge, tent close-range fire, and CornerShot theories.
why_interesting: It lays out the rigged-lapel-mic hypothesis: a PETN micro-charge aimed at the chest that would explain no rifle exit wound, sideways blood, and the rapid paving of the tent area on September 14.

title: Proof Not Tyler — Investigation Index
description: Working memo indexing every forensic, physical, identity, and timeline challenge to the official rooftop rifle story.
why_interesting: It reduces the whole case to five questions the state reportedly cannot answer — starting with whether its own ATF report can link the death fragment to the rifle it says was used.

title: Proof Not Tyler
description: Hub page linking every argument that the official .30-06 rooftop attribution fails on ballistics, wounds, audio, and timing.
why_interesting: It frames the section as a map of gaps in the official kill chain rather than a verdict, and links out to Israeli technology in the investigation and barrel dust and bullet diameter analysis.

title: No Muzzle Flash or Recoil
description: Citizen frame analysis of roof surveillance reportedly showing no muzzle flash and no rifle recoil at the moment Kirk was hit.
why_interesting: Reviewers say the prone roof figure shows no visible muzzle flash and no recoil at shot time, arguing the roof was theater while the lethal mechanism was at the stage.

title: Decoy / No Shot From Roof Claims
description: Theories that the roof figure never fired — no rifle assembly on camera, bag theater, and the screwdriver as a plant.
why_interesting: Footage reportedly never shows a rifle being assembled; the figure throws a bag, goes prone, then leaves with it — read as prop behavior, making the screwdriver corroborate nothing.

title: News Helicopter and the Screwdriver
description: KSL aerial footage of the Losee roof said to show no crime-scene tape and no screwdriver, against Officer Bagley's reported testimony.
why_interesting: Bagley reportedly testified he taped off the railing to protect a red-and-black screwdriver at 12:44 p.m.; reviewers say KSL helicopter video shows no tape and no tool there.

title: Line of Sight Behind the Roof Lip
description: Geometry objection: how a shooter lying flat behind a five-inch roof lip, set back from the edge, could see down into the courtyard.
why_interesting: A prone shooter's eye sits 8-12 inches up; behind a five-inch lip set back from the edge, the sightline reportedly lands out in the plaza, not down on the stage 430 feet away.

title: The Screwdriver and the Crime-Scene Tape
description: Reported testimony placing a screwdriver 15-20 feet past the roof railing, set against aired footage said to show no tape protecting it.
why_interesting: The whole assembled-on-the-roof story leans on one screwdriver 15-20 feet past the railing — an object citizen reviewers say later vanishes from the public aerial record.

title: Pre-Shot Signal Claims
description: Claims the prone roof figure flashed a bright object as a signal seconds before the shot, implying coordination.
why_interesting: Widely shared readings of the Candace Owens footage claim the figure flashed a bright object just before shot time, then fled — a signal, not a shot, implying someone else was cued.

title: The Tactical Roof Run
description: Frame-by-frame measurement of the running roof figure relative to the alleged screwdriver drop point.
why_interesting: Measurement says the runner enters the visible frame 1-3 steps past the screwdriver point, with 10-11 steps between marks — so released video begins after the interval that would show assembly.

title: Multiple Roofs and Other Figures
description: Claims of dark figures on the Woodbury, Sorensen and Sparks roofs the same morning, not only the Losee Center.
why_interesting: A person in all black was reportedly seen on the Woodbury roof about 20 minutes before the shot, with claimed video of figures on three other UVU roofs that day.

title: Military Lateral Crawl
description: Claims the roof figure executed a trained military lateral crawl into prone position on the Candace Owens footage.
why_interesting: Commentators say the figure performs a several-foot sideways low crawl matching soldier training footage — and shows no limp, unlike the limping figure in the approach timeline.

title: Trained Roof Drop / Egress
description: Claims the 16-20 foot drop off the Losee roof was a rehearsed, hesitation-free tactical egress.
why_interesting: On a reported 16-20 foot drop the figure never pauses or scouts the corner, with perfect foot placement while carrying the object — argued as rehearsal, not an untrained first-timer.

title: Roof Figure Identity Claims
description: Stacked arguments that the person on the Losee roof is not the charged defendant.
why_interesting: Defense-aligned hearing commentary reportedly has investigators conceding the roof imagery lacks identifiable facial features — yet a parent is said to have ID'd his son from those distant stills.

title: Black Clothing vs Jeans
description: The clothing conflict between all-black tactical descriptions of the roof figure and the jeans-and-hat casual profile.
why_interesting: Early dispatch and witness language described an all-black tactical figure on the roof, while the official identification package rests on jeans, hat and sunglasses.

title: Roof Timeline — September 10, 2025
description: Minute-by-minute roof-only clock from the 11:50 a.m. approach through the drop and scene processing.
why_interesting: The figure is described as limping at 11:50 and 12:02, but by 12:22 — sprinting west and lying down 430 feet from the stage — the limp is reportedly no longer noticeable.

title: Roof
description: Index to every Losee Center roof dispute: run, crawl, clothing, screwdriver, helicopter, muzzle flash, and identity.
why_interesting: Collects thirteen separate public challenges to the rooftop story in one place, including trimmed rooftop video claims and the officer whose body cam died on the roof.

title: Security & Law Enforcement
description: Splits the private protective detail guarding Kirk at UVU from the government agencies that controlled the scene and prosecution.
why_interesting: Citizen investigators reportedly allege the private detail, which normally planned events far in advance, had no plan for a next event and received raises after the death; rooftop access is described as trivially easy.

title: Brian Harpole
description: Profile of the founder of the firm reported to have run Charlie Kirk's protective detail at UVU.
why_interesting: Harpole, in the SUV with Kirk, reportedly described hearing "two distinct sounds" when Kirk was struck — a detail hard to square with one rifle shot; a separate X post alleges a 2017 photo match, unverified.

title: Shaffer Security Group (SSG)
description: The prior TPUSA security vendor, its deleted post naming the UVU firm, and the Texas corporate record.
why_interesting: A since-deleted @ShafferGroup post (11:33 PM, 9/26/25) said the UVU firm "want to remain in the shadows while my firm takes blame," attaching Rockhouse Integrity Group LLC's Texas file number 0805052578.

title: Integrity Security Solutions
description: The private firm guarding Kirk at UVU, its last-minute hiring, and the open questions about its setup.
why_interesting: Kirk's usual vendor was swapped for a firm reportedly rehired at the last minute for "specialized security," with no bodycams on the detail — yet witnesses say familiar white-shirt agents from earlier stops appeared.

title: Dan Flood — Head of Security
description: Profile of Kirk's reported head of security, the SUV response, and attributed claims about his other clients.
why_interesting: Candace Owens reports Kirk messaged Flood by Signal and Telegram the night before, saying he thought he would be "executed tomorrow" — reportedly telling Frank Turek "they're going to take me out."

title: No Counter-Snipers or Secret Service
description: Reported absence of counter-sniper overwatch, drones, bodycams, and any federal protective layer at UVU.
why_interesting: No counter-snipers, no drones, no bodycams: rooftops and airspace were reportedly treated as "beyond Charlie's bubble," so no one owned the high ground the official story says the shot came from.

title: Perimeter & Rooftop Failures
description: The uninspected Losee Center rooftop, the affidavit timeline, and Harpole's pre-event rooftop warnings.
why_interesting: Harpole reportedly texted UVU Chief Jeff Long about rooftop concerns before the event; ballistics commentary notes a 5-9 degree Losee downward angle should hit face or jaw, not the observed neck path.

title: Greg Shaffer
description: Interview claims from the prior vendor's founder about how the UVU firm came to guard Kirk.
why_interesting: Shaffer said publicly he was "stabbed in the back" over the last-minute switch, and the page separates him from Greg Schaffer, a twenty-year FBI agent who co-founded SSG with Brian Harpole.

title: Screening & Credential Gaps
description: Who was admitted to the Q&A line at UVU, and the unverified claim of revoked credentials.
why_interesting: A post claims Hunter Kozak and "UN-Eff America" affiliates had reportedly had credentials revoked from Kirk events, yet Kozak asked the final question before the fatal moment — "Who let him in line?"

title: The Next Event Had No Security Plan
description: Anonymous claims that no security plan existed for Kirk's next stop, scheduled for September 11.
why_interesting: Anonymous posts allege no written plan existed for Therese Bible College on September 11, the day after — paired with a claim Flood was moonlighting security for Dallas billionaires at the Cattle Barons Ball.

title: Bobby Harpole
description: Reported background of the security-firm founder's father, presented as attributed open-source claims.
why_interesting: Per @ProjectConstitu, the detail founder's father is a retired Erath County Sheriff's Captain and Texas DPS trooper, described as a Past Master Mason of Lodge #267 who now works in funeral services.

title: Security Team
description: Index and summary of the private protective detail, the firms involved, and the reported protection failures.
why_interesting: Six UVU officers — about a quarter of the entire campus department — plus a last-minute private detail were the whole protective layer, with rooftops reportedly inspected by nobody.

title: Social Media Analysis
description: Covers viral X compilations about event AV staff, SD-card handling, Discord artifacts, and platform throttling of investigators.
why_interesting: X posters allege event camera SD cards were removed and handed off before any police evidence seal, with later testimony reportedly citing a flash drive and Google links rather than original cards.

title: Black-Clad Fugitive Escape Path
description: Retraces every reported sighting of the masked all-black figure who left the Losee Center roof on September 10, 2025.
why_interesting: Dispatch described a man in black tactical helmet, mask and vest; a firearms-experienced witness reportedly called him "highly trained," and the fleeing man allegedly had long black greasy hair.

title: Possible Shooter Locations
description: Compares the official Losee rooftop theory against tent-adjacent and vehicle-based origins using ballistics, acoustics and affidavit timing.
why_interesting: Investigators calculate the rooftop runner began sprinting at 12:23:28, two seconds BEFORE impact at 12:23:30, and that a 5-9 degree Losee angle would strike the face, not the neck.

title: Grey Van Shooter — Laser POI
description: Person-of-interest analysis of a grey van under the tent tunnel, its infrared laser, hatch timing and acoustic triangulation claims.
why_interesting: An infrared laser reportedly reflected on Frank Turek's phone screen traces back inside a grey van; the van's rear hatch allegedly opened ~4 seconds before the shot and slammed shut after.

title: Construction Site Gunman Contact
description: On-scene video reporting an excavator operator's contact with a fleeing man, plus an unsecured crime scene above the shooting.
why_interesting: An excavator operator reportedly spoke with the fleeing man before any sirens sounded, and the reporter says he wandered freely among FBI evidence markers because the scene was unsecured for hours.

title: Escape-Path Video: Full Transcript
description: Complete searchable transcript of the August 7, 2026 escape-path investigation video, with broadcast clips and eyewitness quotes.
why_interesting: The source post asks how an eyewitness met the fugitive still in full black tactical gear AFTER the alleged clothes change in the woods — used to argue the text confession is fabricated.

title: Suspects Investigation Index
description: Question-first map of every suspect thread, organized into evidence lanes with source tiers for each reported claim.
