why_interesting: A K9 reportedly tracked the suspect through 785 College Dr, and the sheriff's photo shown to construction workers allegedly did not match the image the FBI released publicly.

title: Suspects
description: Section entry point summarizing the black-clad suspect, grey van, acoustic and person-of-interest lanes that conflict with the official narrative.
why_interesting: Former NCTC director Joe Kent has said on the record that his center's parallel search for other actors — specifically foreign ties — was ordered stopped once Robinson was in custody.

title: The Courtyard Paved Over Days After the Shooting (Claims)
description: The UVU courtyard where Charlie Kirk was shot was reportedly paved over four days later.
why_interesting: A contractor says on camera he was told 'the governor and the FBI said they want this done by Monday' — the crime scene was reportedly paved four days after the shooting.

title: Patel Reportedly Shut Down the Kent Probe (Claims)
description: Reporting that the FBI director halted a counterterrorism review of a possible foreign nexus.
why_interesting: Per Daily Mail reporting, FBI Director Kash Patel allegedly shut down Joe Kent's counterterrorism review of a possible foreign nexus to the killing — the foreign angle was reportedly closed from inside.

title: Ryne Simmons Reportedly Told to Delete His 4K Video (Claims)
description: A named witness says he gave the FBI his 4K shooting footage and was then told to delete it.
why_interesting: Witness Ryne Simmons says he sent his own 4K footage of the shooting to the FBI and was then instructed to delete his copy, with follow-up calls afterward.

title: Sixteen Israeli-Registered Phones at UVU (Claims)
description: An analyst's claim that dozens of foreign-registered phones were near Kirk on September 10.
why_interesting: An analyst reportedly claims raw GPS ad data put 44 foreign-registered phones near Charlie Kirk on Sept 10, 2025 — 16 of them Israeli-registered. The dataset has never been published.

title: Miranda at 6:25 PM Versus Sheriff Brooksby's Account (Claims)
description: Court filings reportedly place Robinson's Miranda warning hours before the tip that supposedly identified him.
why_interesting: Filings reportedly show Tyler Robinson Mirandized at 6:25pm Sept 11 — before the 8:04pm tip call that supposedly identified him and 90 minutes before the Discord confession.

title: The Donor Texts, 48 Hours Before (Claims)
description: Messages reportedly sent by Kirk two days before his death about donor pressure over Israel.
why_interesting: Candace Owens released Sept 8, 2025 messages in which Kirk reportedly wrote donor pressure was leaving him no choice but to leave the pro-Israel cause — 48 hours before he died.

title: No Blood Spray, No Exit Wound (Claims)
description: The core physical objection: a .30-06 neck hit should have produced an exit wound and spray.
why_interesting: The most-repeated objection to the rifle account: a .30-06 at that range should have blown through the neck and sprayed blood, and analysts say neither happened.

title: The Shirt and Necklace Move Before the Blood (Claims)
description: Frame analysis claiming Kirk's shirt and chain move before any blood appears.
why_interesting: Analysts argue the shirt balloons outward and the necklace chain snaps several frames BEFORE any blood appears — read as something detonating under the shirt rather than a bullet arriving.

title: SAM-702 to Fort Huachuca — the VIP Flight Claim
description: Trackers allege a USAF VIP jet sat at Fort Huachuca the day before.
why_interesting: Citizen trackers allege USAF VIP jet SAM-702 sat at Fort Huachuca and departed the day before Kirk was killed. No manifest released.

title: N1098L: The HADES Aircraft's Low Passes (Claims)
description: An Army-linked ISR surveillance jet reportedly made low slow passes near UVU on September 10.
why_interesting: Citizen trackers say N1098L, an Army HADES-program ISR jet, made two low slow passes near UVU on Sept 10, 2025 — a signals-intelligence aircraft over the venue that day.

title: UVU GRAMA Records Show Pre-Shooting Warnings (Claims)
description: A public-records production reportedly showing warnings to UVU the night before.
why_interesting: A 112-page GRAMA production reportedly shows two men warning UVU about 'a plan' 14 hours before the shooting, plus a redacted message request directed to Charlie Kirk.

title: Joe Kent's NCTC Foreign-Nexus Probe Halted (Claims)
description: NCTC's director reportedly opened a foreign-interference inquiry that was then shut down.
why_interesting: Reporting says NCTC Director Joe Kent opened a foreign-interference inquiry into the Kirk killing — and that it was shut down before it could report.

title: Missing Surrender CCTV and Bodycam Footage (Claims)
description: No bodycam exists and lobby CCTV was purged for the surrender of the accused killer.
why_interesting: Washington County reportedly told a records appeal that NO bodycam footage of Tyler Robinson's surrender exists and the lobby CCTV was purged at 30 days.

title: The ATF Fragment Shows Only Class Characteristics (Claims)
description: The ATF lab could reportedly neither match nor exclude the seized rifle from the recovered fragment.
why_interesting: The ATF's Sept 17, 2025 lab report reportedly could neither identify nor exclude Robinson's Mauser as the source of the recovered jacket fragment — no forensic link to the rifle.

title: The Canon XA55 Audio and a Stage Detonation (Claims)
description: Audio analysis of a broadcast camera claiming three separate low-frequency arrivals.
why_interesting: An analysis of uncompressed Canon XA55 broadcast audio claims three low-frequency arrivals — including one read as a detonation at the tent itself, not a distant rifle.

title: The Shirt Pulled at the Instant of the Shot (Claims)
description: A 4K close-up read as showing an object driven upward under Kirk's shirt.
why_interesting: Proponents read a 4K close-up as showing an object driven up under Kirk's shirt at the instant of the shot — but the theory's own cited explosives expert says a charge would move it the other way.

title: Stairs Guy and the Backpack That Doesn't Fit (Claims)
description: Analysis arguing the stairwell figure is not the accused because the gear does not match.
why_interesting: Investigators argue the stairwell figure is a different person entirely: the backpack and hat don't match, and a Mauser 98 reportedly will not physically fit in that bag.

title: Four of Those Phones Later at the Islamabad Serena (Claims)
description: A claim that four devices from UVU later pinged at a hotel during US-Iran talks.
why_interesting: An analyst reportedly claims four of the alleged UVU Israeli-registered devices later pinged at the Islamabad Serena during April 2026 US-Iran talks; the circulated graphic was admitted to be a recreation.

title: The Fort Huachuca JTF Meeting (Claims)
description: A whistleblower's account of a closed high-clearance meeting the day before the killing.
why_interesting: A whistleblower says he walked in on a closed, high-clearance joint task force meeting at Fort Huachuca the day before Charlie Kirk was killed.

title: Feds Directed the Re-Search That Found the Rifle (Claims)
description: The claim the rifle only appeared after federal agents sent local officers back to search again.
why_interesting: The claim that hands found no gun and dogs found no gun in the woods — and the Mauser turned up only after federal agents directed junior local officers to search the area again.

title: KSL's Chopper 5 and the Screwdriver That Isn't There (Claims)
description: Helicopter aerial footage reportedly shows no screwdriver where an officer said he found one.
why_interesting: KSL's news helicopter N155TV was over the Losee roof from about 1:38pm on Sept 10, and citizen investigators argue its aerial footage shows no screwdriver where Officer Bagley reportedly found one.

title: Counter-UAS Gear Tested at Provo, Sept 4-10 (Claims)
description: Anonymous claims that anti-drone equipment was tested at Provo Airport that week.
why_interesting: An OSINT researcher reports anonymous claims that counter-drone equipment was being tested at Provo Airport during the exact week ending with Charlie Kirk's death.

title: Booking Sheet Arrest Time Contradicts the Affidavit (Claims)
description: Two official records reportedly give different arrest times for the accused.
why_interesting: Booking paperwork reportedly lists a 10:00pm Sept 11 arrest while a submission record lists 04:00 Sept 12 — six hours the official paperwork cannot reconcile.

title: The Senior Executive Who Collected the SD Cards (Claims)
description: A claim that a TPUSA executive who never attends campus stops took the camera memory cards.
why_interesting: Candace Owens says a top TPUSA executive who never works campus stops was at UVU that day and collected the camera SD cards afterward.

title: The Shot-Through-the-Heart Narrative (Claims)
description: A thesis that early witnesses described a chest wound because a shaped charge was aimed there.
why_interesting: A thesis that the earliest on-camera witnesses all described a chest-and-heart wound because that is the wound a shaped charge was meant to produce — before it reportedly tilted and struck the neck.

title: The Mic Placed Under, Not Over, the Shirt (Claims)
description: Kirk's wireless transmitter was reportedly worn against his torso beneath his shirt.
why_interesting: Kirk's RODE transmitter was reportedly worn UNDER his shirt against his torso — the physical precondition every contact-device theory requires, though it is also routine practice.

title: Six Campus Officers and No Ambulance Staged (Claims)
description: Records show minimal security and no staged ambulance for a 3,000-person outdoor event.
why_interesting: Records requests reportedly show UVU assigned just six campus officers and staged no ambulance at all for a 3,000-person outdoor event with a national figure.

title: The GGLF 2023 LLC Life-Insurance Policy (Claims)
description: A claimed life-insurance policy on Kirk tied to a Wyoming LLC.
why_interesting: Researchers claim a life-insurance policy was taken out on Charlie Kirk right after he questioned October 7 — though the Wyoming filing offered as proof shows the LLC formed five months earlier.

title: The Prosecution Disclaimed the Extraction Evidence (Claims)
description: A State filing reportedly declining to offer the phone-extraction evidence at trial.
why_interesting: A State filing reportedly says it will not offer the forensic phone-extraction evidence — the very source of the entire Discord confession narrative the public was given.

title: Provo Airport Badge Access List Modified 9/11/25 (Claims)
description: A claim the airport's badge access list was altered the day after the assassination.
why_interesting: The Provo Airport badge access list was reportedly modified on September 11, 2025 — the day after the assassination. No document has been produced.

title: Bomb Dogs Reportedly Kept From Parts of the Scene (Claims)
description: A claim that explosive-detection dogs were kept out of certain areas at UVU.
why_interesting: Candace Owens has claimed the FBI did not want bomb dogs in certain places at UVU — a keystone of the rigged-device theory, though the file records dogs called at 11:17am.

title: The Banned CBLA Bullet-Lead Test (Claims)

why_interesting: On stage, a speaker identified by posters as Turning Point's COO reportedly used the word "handler" — not assistant — to describe someone attached to Charlie Kirk.

title: No Security Plan for the September 11, 2025 Event (Alleged)
description: Candace Owens alleged, citing a tipster, that TPUSA security had no plan or police coordination for Kirk's next-day Colorado appearance.
why_interesting: Candace Owens alleged that for Kirk's September 11 Colorado event — the day after he died — TPUSA security had reportedly arranged no plan and no police coordination at all.

title: LASAI Aviation II LLC — Operator of N1098L (Claims)
description: The defense-contractor operator reportedly behind the N1098L jet tracked around the Charlie Kirk timeline.
why_interesting: The jet N1098L tracked around the timeline is reportedly operated by a defense contractor described as an ISR — intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance — outfit.

title: N888KG LLC — Post-Shooting Jet (Claims)
description: A Utah LLC owning tail number N888KG, a private jet flight-trackers say departed near Provo about an hour after the shooting.
why_interesting: Flight trackers say a private jet, N888KG, lifted off near Provo roughly one hour after Kirk was shot; its owner is an anonymous Utah LLC and passengers are unknown.

title: Clock Tower X LLC — Brad Parscale (Claims)
description: A Parscale LLC whose FARA filing dated September 18, 2025 reportedly covered Israeli-government messaging routed into Salem Media.
why_interesting: A foreign-agent registration reportedly filed September 18, 2025 — eight days after the assassination — covered Israeli-government messaging work routed into the network that carried Kirk's show.

title: Hardscape Specialties LLC — UVU Tent Paving (Claims)
description: The company reported to have paved the UVU tent area, part of the disputed rapid re-paving of the crime scene.
why_interesting: The ground where the tent stood was reportedly re-paved shortly after the shooting — the page names the contractor and asks whether the work was pre-scheduled or arranged after September 10.

title: Salem Media (Claims)
description: The conservative media company carrying Kirk's show, whose properties a Parscale FARA filing reportedly targeted for foreign-government messaging.
why_interesting: The network that carried The Charlie Kirk Show is reportedly named in a foreign-agent filing as a target for integrating Israeli-government messaging.

title: Fourteen Ways TPUSA Went the Opposite Direction After Kirk
description: Fourteen areas where post-death TPUSA leadership allegedly reversed positions Charlie Kirk publicly held while alive.
why_interesting: Fourteen separate documented reversals — Thomas Massie, Iran policy, the audit — where the organization allegedly turned against its dead founder's own stated positions.

title: TPUSA Leadership Succession After Kirk's Death
description: Reported hour-by-hour timeline of leadership announcements and media appearances following the assassination.
why_interesting: The speed of the succession is the story: leadership announcements and coordinated media appearances reportedly began within hours of the shooting.

title: Does TPUSA Support the Iran War After Charlie?
description: Whether TPUSA and the show shifted toward backing U.S. strikes on Iran after Kirk's death, through 2026 air-campaign commentary.
why_interesting: Kirk was a prominent voice against new Middle East wars; after his death the show he built reportedly moved toward supporting a U.S. air campaign on Iran.

title: July 31 White House Meeting Without TPUSA
description: An off-the-record July 31, 2025 White House strategy session on Israel and MAGA antisemitism held without Kirk or TPUSA.
why_interesting: Six weeks before he was killed, the most influential young-conservative organizer in America was reportedly left out of an off-the-record White House session about his own movement.

title: Why TPUSA Was Absent on July 31
description: Focused analysis of why investigators treat Kirk's exclusion from the July 31, 2025 White House Israel session as significant.
why_interesting: Investigators argue the exclusion was not an oversight but a signal that Kirk had become the obstacle in a donor-driven messaging strategy.

title: Moore DM Group / Resource One (Claims)
description: A direct-mail company citizen investigators say is the real entity behind TPUSA's Resource One line, alleging a large reporting gap.
why_interesting: Investigators allege more than $9 million was paid to a direct-mail operation while only about $1.35 million appeared in the reported filings — a claim TPUSA disputes.

title: Superfeed Technologies (Claims)
description: A technology company whose board reportedly includes Erika Kirk's mother alongside Turning Point Action's COO, with alleged money routed from TP Action.
why_interesting: Erika Kirk's mother reportedly sits on a company board alongside Turning Point Action's COO, with money allegedly routed from the political arm into that company.

title: America's Turning Point (501c3)
description: A sibling 501(c)(3) run by Tyler Bowyer funded almost entirely by transfers from TPUSA, including a reported $8.6M grant.
why_interesting: A sibling charity reportedly received an $8.6 million transfer from TPUSA and is alleged to carry roughly 80 employees who do not appear in the parent's reporting.

title: Turning Point Action (501c4)
description: The 501(c)(4) political arm, its Chase the Vote ballot operation, FY24 budget jump, and the disputed under-reporting question.
why_interesting: The political arm's budget reportedly jumped sharply in FY24 while investigators allege political spending was booked in entities not permitted to do it — disputed by TPUSA.

title: Turning Point Endowment (501c3)
description: The 501(c)(3) holding Turning Point's investments and the attributed claim that its 990 filings were among those missing.
why_interesting: The entity holding the movement's investment money is reportedly among those whose public 990 tax filings investigators say cannot be located.

title: Clocktower LLC (Claims)
description: A dissolved LLC reported to have received a large TPUSA research-project payment with no public deliverables.
why_interesting: A now-dissolved shell reportedly received a large TPUSA payment for a "research project" for which no deliverable was ever made public.

title: Lionrock LLC (Claims)
description: A limited-liability company reported as one of several shell entities allegedly tied to a TPUSA advancement director.
why_interesting: Investigators allege a single TPUSA fundraising staffer was connected to multiple shell LLCs receiving organizational money.

title: Cloverstone LLC (Claims)
description: A second LLC named in reporting as allegedly tied to the same TPUSA advancement director.
why_interesting: A second shell entity, allegedly linked to the same TPUSA advancement director, appears in the same donor-money chain — a pattern rather than an isolated filing.

title: 1Ten LLC (Claims)
description: An LLC named in citizen reporting in connection with TPUSA direct-mail payments and an Arizona political figure.
why_interesting: TPUSA direct-mail money is alleged to have flowed through an LLC connected to a sitting Arizona political figure.

title: RobinsonSTG LLC (Claims)
description: A St. George, Utah LLC that unverified claims associate with a member of the accused's family through a shared registered agent.
why_interesting: Unverified claims connect a St. George LLC to the accused's family via a shared registered agent — the page flags it explicitly as rumor-level.

title: Precision Granite & Marble LLC (Claims)
description: A masonry LLC that unverified claims associate with the Robinson family and, speculatively, with UVU tent-area construction.
why_interesting: An unverified thread tries to link a masonry company to both the accused's family and the UVU tent-area hardscaping — recorded here and marked unproven.

title: Rockhouse Integrity Group LLC (Integrity Security Solutions)
description: The LLC doing business as Integrity Security Solutions, the security vendor connected to Kirk's protective arrangements.
why_interesting: The security firm around Kirk's protection operated under a different legal name than its trading name — Rockhouse Integrity Group doing business as Integrity Security Solutions.

title: Baker Tilly — TPUSA's Auditor (Claims)
description: The accounting firm reportedly performing Turning Point's annual audit, one said to have concluded June 20, 2025.
why_interesting: A clean outside audit reportedly closed on June 20, 2025 — yet Kirk reportedly ordered a far more aggressive internal audit ten weeks later, on September 2.

title: T.W. Lewis Aviation LLC (Claims)
description: The aviation LLC tied to a conservative donor foundation that lists TPUSA as a key partner; an aircraft was tracked near the timeline.
why_interesting: A major TPUSA donor's aviation LLC owns an aircraft that flight trackers place near the case timeline.

title: T.W. Lewis Foundation
description: A conservative donor foundation reportedly listing TPUSA as a key partner, with an associated aviation LLC.
why_interesting: The same donor foundation that funds TPUSA also controls an aviation LLC whose aircraft appears in the flight-tracking analysis.

title: Turning Point USA (501c3)
description: The flagship charity Kirk founded and led, its charitable purpose, and the financial questions raised after his death.
why_interesting: The flagship charity's own 501(c)(3) status is the pivot of the dispute: political spending is restricted there, and investigators allege it happened anyway.

title: Paul Singer and Conservative Funding Networks
description: Public reporting on a billionaire's funding ties to pro-Israel advocacy groups connected to pre-assassination political meetings.
why_interesting: The donor network behind the July 31 White House session is traceable in public reporting to a single billionaire funder of pro-Israel advocacy groups.

title: Philos Project and Pro-Israel Advocacy Funding
description: The Philos Project's role in pro-Israel conservative advocacy and its connection to the July 31, 2025 White House meeting.
why_interesting: A named advocacy nonprofit is documented as a participant in the July 31 White House session convened specifically about "MAGA antisemitism" — the fight Kirk was on the other side of.

title: Faith & Freedom Coalition (July 31 Context)
description: The coalition's reported role organizing the July 31, 2025 White House strategy session and its place in donor-alignment timelines.
why_interesting: The July 31 session was reportedly organized by an outside coalition rather than the White House itself — donors, not government, set the guest list that excluded Kirk.

title: Trump Administration Response After Kirk's Death
description: Documented White House and administration responses after the killing — the medal, investigation statements, and political framing.
why_interesting: The administration moved quickly to honors and framing while, per this page's chronology, saying strikingly little about the physical evidence itself.

title: Tyler Robinson Weapon and Rifle
description: The Mauser .30-06 attributed to Robinson: recovery, DNA claims, ATF inconclusive match, barrel dust, and wound-trajectory challenges.
why_interesting: The ATF reportedly could not identify or exclude the autopsy bullet fragment as fired from the Mauser, and hearing testimony described dust inside the barrel and a fragment measuring .286-.301 inches.

title: Cowboy's Smokehouse Receipt
description: A photographed 9/10/25 restaurant receipt circulated as a possible alibi placing Robinson far from UVU that night.
why_interesting: Check #211, Table 24: ordered 8:55 PM and paid 9:47 PM on the day of the assassination, $38.51 on a Visa debit — circulated as an alibi, unauthenticated by any court.

title: Tyler Robinson Surrender — September 11
description: The September 11 Washington County surrender: Brooksby timeline, 6:25 PM Miranda conflict, missing bodycam and lobby CCTV.
why_interesting: Materials place Robinson Mirandized at 6:25 PM — before the 8:04 PM sheriff call and before the 7:57 PM Discord confession — while the county reportedly found zero bodycam and no lobby CCTV.

title: Tyler Robinson Discord Messages
description: The alleged Discord confession: warrant targets, the 7:57 PM vs 6:25 PM custody conflict, and internal message contradictions.
why_interesting: The confession posts reportedly appeared at 7:57 PM on September 11, roughly ninety minutes after Robinson was already Mirandized in custody at 6:25 PM without phone access.

title: Eyewitness vs. the Text Confession
description: A construction-site electrician's description of the fleeing man collides with the alleged texts saying he had already changed clothes.
why_interesting: The texts say he changed outfits in the woods, yet an electrician reportedly described the man afterward as still in a black trench coat, black mask, cargo pants and long greasy black hair.

title: Cowboy's Smokehouse Full Visit Video
description: Full 34-minute citizen-journalist visit where the owner hands over the 9/10/25 receipt and a staff eyewitness is interviewed on camera.
why_interesting: A Panguitch restaurant staffer says he is 100% certain he served Tyler Robinson between 8:55 and 9:47 PM on the night of the assassination; the owner reportedly says no camera was working.

title: Tyler Robinson — Risk of Assassination
description: Baron Coleman's claim that Robinson is in grave physical danger and that the case cannot survive a trial.
why_interesting: Coleman states on camera he is 100% convinced Robinson was framed and was never supposed to survive to turn himself in — and names Robinson as only the first of two people in grave danger.

title: Clothing Change & Agent David Hull
description: Agent Hull's testimony that the suspect changed clothes on the Losee Center roof and then changed back before arrest.
why_interesting: A rooftop change of clothes — and a change back into the morning outfit — was reportedly testified to at the preliminary hearing yet never captured on any surveillance camera.

title: Stairs Guy vs Tyler Robinson
description: Six clothing, backpack and rifle-carry mismatches between the campus-camera figure and the stairwell suspect.
why_interesting: The morning figure carries a light blue pack about half full; the stairwell figure's pack is 90-95% full — the opposite of what removing shorts during an outfit change should produce.

title: Baron Coleman — Family Denies the Confession
description: Coleman's account on Julian Dorey Episode 458 that Robinson's family does not believe he did it and denies a confession.
why_interesting: Coleman says he has seen family text messages and that the parents do not believe their son did it — and notes the parents were not on the preliminary-hearing witness list.

title: Tyler Robinson on September 10, 2025
description: Minute-by-minute reported movements on the day of the shooting, including the 25-second egress window.
why_interesting: Surveillance stills timestamped 12:23:29 to 12:23:54 put the figure from shooting position to the Losee Center NE corner in 25 seconds — and a pronounced limp reportedly vanishes at 12:22.

title: Text Messages — Recovered From Lance Twiggs' Phone
description: The Robinson-Twiggs texts came off Twiggs' handset via Cellebrite extraction, not from any device attributed to Robinson.
why_interesting: The state's largest message exhibit (16.1, 17+ pages) was never pulled from Robinson's own phone; it was Cellebrite-extracted from his roommate's device by the Israeli firm Cellebrite.

title: Tyler Robinson Recruited
description: Claims and hypotheses that Robinson was monitored, influenced, or recruited by intelligence or politically connected networks.
why_interesting: Former NCTC director Joe Kent has stated his center was still early in examining potential international ties in the Kirk case when it was ordered to stop because a suspect was in custody.

title: Lance Twiggs Drawings
description: Photographs of frenzied notebook and sticky-note drawings reportedly recovered from the shared apartment, and evidence-handling questions.
why_interesting: The pages are held bare-handed in the photos — no gloves — and one gallery screenshot ends on the 09/11/2025 9:57 PM Discord confession message from user zealous_monkey_5.

title: Discord Messages — Stored on a Third-Party Server
description: How the alleged Discord confession reached investigators and how it appears as State's Exhibit 16.2 in a court filing.
why_interesting: The filing's quotation reads "it was [me]. ... look at the pictures from the surveillance footage" — bracketed and elided in the document itself, meaning the public has seen photographs, not exports.

title: Tyler Robinson Investigation Index
description: Working memo mapping identity, timeline, and forensic layers of the case, including the two-versions-of-the-texts theory.
why_interesting: It argues the released text messages exist in two conflicting versions, and lists a forensic layer where the ATF fragment is inconclusive and a shaped-charge cause would exonerate Robinson.

title: The Handwritten Note — Stored Under a Keyboard
description: The paper note left under a keyboard — the only message in the case with no server, timestamp or metadata.
why_interesting: The memorandum sometimes describes Exhibit 16.3 as something Robinson "wrote to Mr. Twiggs," which reads like a message rather than paper under a keyboard — a live authentication problem.

title: Tyler Robinson Travel
description: Camera-by-camera reconstruction of movements on 9/10, the rifle drop-off route, and the Dairy Queen sighting.
why_interesting: Construction workers near the recovered rifle reportedly encountered a man in black they first believed was the gunman, and were later told he did not match Robinson's appearance.

title: Tyler Robinson Family
description: Reported family background, the turn-in chain through a retired deputy, and January 2026 hearing statements.
why_interesting: Investigators who attended the January 16, 2026 hearing report the family told them face-to-face that they do not think he did this — and the turn-in may not have started with the parents.

title: Tyler Robinson Trial
description: Charges, capital-case posture, the defense team, and the gag order restricting public discussion.
why_interesting: A Google Trends spike in searches for lead defense counsel Kathryn Nester's name was reportedly traced to foreign IP addresses months before the killing.

title: Tyler Robinson Before the Event
description: Pre-September-10 biography: schooling, the St. George townhouse, family, vehicle, and pre-event search-interest anomalies.
why_interesting: Investigators claim the St. George townhouse address was searched nonstop from December 2024 to September 2025, arguing someone knew where he lived months before the shooting.

title: Steam Profile and Comments
description: Archived Steam material attributed to Robinson — the craftin247 and milk profiles — scraped before the pages were reportedly scrubbed.
why_interesting: The eleven-year gaming profile was renamed from craftin247 to milk and the public pages were reportedly scrubbed after the event; Steam appears nowhere in the state's 16-16.4 exhibit series.

title: The Messages Attributed to Tyler Robinson
description: Sorts every message set attributed to Robinson by where it was stored and how it reached investigators.
why_interesting: The state's 28-page bindover memorandum files the entire message case as Exhibits 16 through 16.4 — texts, Discord, note — meaning four different storage locations with four different authentication problems.

title: Tyler Robinson Shooting
description: The official rooftop-shooter account set against ballistics, timing, identity and alternative-cause challenges.
why_interesting: The page notes independent audio-visual analyses place the shot closer than the rooftop distance, and that the .30-06 narrative collapses if an internal device is confirmed.

title: Tyler Robinson
description: Hub page for the official suspect, linking identity, timeline, surrender, messages, ballistics and alibi threads.
why_interesting: The hub states plainly that the majority of citizen investigators on X are converging on an explosive in the mic rather than any .30-06 bullet attributed to Robinson.

title: .30-06 Did Not Kill Charlie
description: Forensic case that the recovered rifle and the autopsy fragment cannot be matched, and that the wound physics contradict a .30-06 shot.
why_interesting: ATF examiner Samantha Karner reportedly testified the fragment could not be tied to the Mauser and that "saying anything but inconclusive was inappropriate"; a fragment measured ~.301 versus .308.

title: Explosive in Mic Likely Killed Charlie
description: Argument that a concealed shaped charge or EFP in Kirk's RODE microphone transmitter or pendant, not a rifle, caused his death.
why_interesting: Investigators reportedly argue the RODE Wireless PRO battery detonated like the Hezbollah pager attacks, and demand chain-of-custody on who clipped the mic on Kirk that day.

title: Faked Confession (by Powerful People)
description: Timeline and custody analysis questioning who actually typed the Discord messages treated as Robinson's confession.
why_interesting: Miranda was reportedly read at 6:25 PM but the "it was me" Discord messages are timestamped ~7:57 PM — after the phone was allegedly already in custody; the roommate called it "a joke on Discord".

title: Signs of a Cover-Up
description: Catalogue of rapid scene clearing, excavation, deleted footage, seized camera media, and a destroyed transport vehicle.
why_interesting: A reported ~10-inch soil excavation before repaving the shooting area, a camera chip removed within minutes, a refused surrender video, and destruction of the transport vehicle.

title: More Reasons Robinson Is Not the Assassin
description: Roundup of secondary evidentiary gaps: no GSR test, mixed DNA, unmatched prints, no video of the shot, backpack problems.
why_interesting: No gunshot-residue test was reportedly ever performed, DNA on the weapon was mixed, roof-glass fingerprints reportedly do not match, and no video captures the shot itself.

title: Tyler Robinson Not the Assassin
description: Section hub summarizing forensic, confession, and cover-up clusters arguing the charged suspect is not the killer.
why_interesting: Embeds a video claiming Robinson's home address was Googled in Hebrew from an Egyptian jet, and notes Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene publicly questioning the official narrative.

title: Joe Kent
description: NCTC director Joe Kent's on-record account that his foreign-ties inquiry into Kirk's death was halted early.
why_interesting: The sitting NCTC director says on camera his team was told to "stop what you're doing now because we have a suspect" — pulled off foreign-nexus leads he says were unfinished.

title: Fort Huachuca
description: Hub page on the Army Intelligence Center and the reported Sept 8-9, 2025 activity two days before the shooting.
why_interesting: Roughly twelve lieutenant colonels reportedly met at the Army's counterintelligence school 36 hours before the killing, an Air Force VIP jet came and went, and a walk-in witness says he was detained.

title: NSA
description: NSA Utah Data Center, the 12 Israeli-phone tip, and Tony Seruga's 44 foreign-registered phone claims.
why_interesting: An admin-insider tip claims NSA detected 12 Israeli-registered cellphones at the shooting site; investigator Tony Seruga puts the total at 44 foreign phones — 16 Israeli, 13 Chinese, 12 Russian, 3 Iranian.

title: US Army HADES (Drone Launching Planes)
description: The Army's Global 6500 ISR program, deleted drone-launch reporting, and N1098L's passes over UVU.
why_interesting: N1098L, the jet flight-trackers place low over UVU hours before and minutes after the shooting, is the same Global 6500 airframe type as the Army's HADES program — yet it very likely was a training plane, not one built out to launch drones.

title: NCTC — National Counterterrorism Center
description: The counterterrorism center's foreign-involvement inquiry, the reported shutdown, and Benny Johnson's state-actor remark.
why_interesting: Benny Johnson said on record there is "considerable evidence that there were state actors involved" and would go no further; the file notes he reportedly met officials the next day over death threats.

title: Cabot Phillips alibi video — Fort Huachuca carpet claim
description: An X investigator's side-by-side claim that an alibi video's carpet, trim, and yellow wall match Fort Huachuca interiors.
why_interesting: An open-source analyst claims the carpet pattern, dark floor trim, and yellow wall in a publicly posted alibi video appear to match Army Intelligence Center rooms — a visual-similarity claim, not a forensic match.

title: CIA
description: CIA-linked claims: UVU National Security Society profiles removed, HADES flights, and a 1954 ARTICHOKE memo.
why_interesting: Investigation notes say UVU's National Security Society online profiles were taken down on September 24, 2025 — two weeks after the shooting; researchers also circulate a 1954 CIA ARTICHOKE assassination-induction memo.

title: ODNI
description: ODNI's oversight of the halted NCTC inquiry, its SIGINT consolidation power, and cabinet-level shutdown claims.
why_interesting: Russell Brand says two cabinet-meeting sources described officials directing, about six days after the killing, that no one pursue foreign involvement or domestic accomplices — an unverified account of unnamed sources.

title: Tulsi Gabbard
description: The DNI's role above the halted NCTC inquiry, the Macron-allegation reply, and reported friction over case control.
why_interesting: Candace Owens reports that when she raised an alleged foreign directive, the FBI, DOJ, and White House never answered — and only the DNI's office replied at all.

title: U.S. Intelligence Investigation Index
description: Working memo mapping every U.S. intelligence thread by question — signals, aircraft, campus, Fort Huachuca, cover-up.
why_interesting: A single table sorts the signals lane by source tier, including the claim that four of the sixteen Israeli-registered phones later showed up at a Pakistan hotel during high-level peace talks.

title: U.S. Intelligence
description: Section landing page routing readers to the CIA, NSA, ODNI/NCTC, HADES, and Fort Huachuca threads.
why_interesting: Frames the most documented attributable thread as a named sitting intelligence director publicly stating the FBI halted his own agency's foreign-nexus inquiry into the assassination.

title: RØDE Mic
description: Examines the lapel microphone Charlie Kirk wore as the suspected explosive device and its defense supply-chain links.
why_interesting: The mic clipped under Kirk's shirt via a MagClip GO is argued by video analysts like Jon Bray to be the energy source, reportedly tied to a DoD explosives supply chain.

title: Signs of Cover-Up
description: Inventories the aftermath pattern: sealed records, disposed evidence, a Dec 16 2025 gag order, and closed foreign-angle inquiries.
why_interesting: The scene was reportedly paved over within days, the SUV disposed of, a broad gag order issued December 16 2025, and FOIA and video-deletion fights followed into 2026.

title: Narrative Control (Intelligence Service)
description: Traces how the lone-suspect frame was locked in and how a foreign-nexus inquiry was reportedly shut down.
why_interesting: An NCTC foreign-nexus inquiry under Joe Kent was reportedly halted, and Russell Brand's anonymous cabinet sources said within six days investigators were not looking at foreign ties or accomplices.

title: Explosion & Killings at AES Factory
description: Covers the October 2025 destruction of the Accurate Energetic Systems explosives plant and its alleged supply-chain relevance.
why_interesting: On October 10 2025, roughly a month after Kirk's death, the Accurate Energetic Systems plant in McEwen, Tennessee was destroyed, reportedly killing workers — investigators call the timing suspicious.

title: Faked Confession
description: Questions the Discord confession attributed to Tyler Robinson as a manufactured artifact for closing the case fast.
why_interesting: The Discord messages appeared around 7:57 PM on September 11 2025 saying in substance it was me, all by myself — unsigned, unsworn, and reportedly conflicting with the custody timeline.

title: Fort Huachuca Attendance at UVU
description: Placeholder page tracking the claim that personnel tied to Fort Huachuca were present at UVU on the day.
why_interesting: Fort Huachuca is the Army's military intelligence home; the claim that people tied to it attended the UVU event is logged here as unproven and still being assembled.

title: US Intelligence Assisted
description: Section landing page introducing the claim that US intelligence assisted the assassination, with sitting-congresswoman commentary.
why_interesting: A sitting member of Congress, Marjorie Taylor Greene, is documented on this page publicly questioning the official account of Charlie Kirk's death.

title: Pavers — Dan Merrell's Account
description: Contractor Dan Merrell's on-camera account of being called to pave over the UVU crime scene days after the shooting.
why_interesting: Merrell says a coordinator told him "the governor and the FBI said they want this done by Monday" — the courtyard was paved Sunday Sept 14, with roughly 8–10 inches of soil reportedly already excavated by an earlier team.

title: The Tent — Exploding Mic Theory
description: The event tent and the argument that a rigged RØDE microphone, not a rooftop rifle, killed Charlie Kirk.
why_interesting: Proponents note a rectangular chest bulge from the RØDE transmitter visible before the event and gone after, with glass and case fragments reportedly photographed on the SUV floorboard — a ~0.5g PETN charge would fit inside.

title: Pre-Shooting Warnings: Two Men Contacted UVU the Night Before
description: GRAMA records showing two separate warnings reached UVU on September 9, both dismissed or undocumented.
why_interesting: At 10:35 PM on Sept 9, two men reportedly came to UVU asking to talk to police about "a plan." At 11:19 PM the chain dismissed them as "GOP reps." Fourteen hours later Kirk was killed.

title: Losee Center (Alleged Sniper Rooftop)
description: The building charging documents name as the firing position, its affidavit timeline, and the contested rooftop video.
why_interesting: Reconstruction of the released rooftop clip reportedly shows the runner beginning an all-out sprint at 12:23:28 while Kirk was struck at 12:23:30 — a two-second gap the analyst argues makes that runner's shot impossible.

title: Stingray Device at UVU (Claims)
description: Allegations of an IMSI-catcher at UVU plus foreign-phone, HADES overflight, and Carbyne surveillance threads.
why_interesting: Posts attributed to Tony Seruga allege 44 foreign-registered phones near Kirk at the shot — reportedly 16 Israeli, 13 Chinese, 12 Russian, 3 Iranian — with four Israeli phones later traced to Islamabad's Serena Hotel.

title: Hardscape Specialties LLC
description: Corporate-record claims about the entity tied to the post-shooting UVU courtyard hardscape work.
why_interesting: Citizen corporate research alleges the LLC sat dormant about 20 years before being revived in February 2025, is owned by a described Utah Attorney General special agent and a former UVU operations staffer, with no public bidding.

title: CIA-Linked UVU Profiles (Claims)
description: Claims that UVU National Security Society profiles were removed shortly after the assassination, plus campus intelligence-adjacent context.
why_interesting: Research notes allege the UVU National Security Society's CNSSI-linked profiles were taken down on September 24, 2025 — fourteen days after the killing — and that the Losee Center's Military-Affiliated Student Hub is absent from UVU's public campus map.

title: UVU Campus Security Gaps on September 10
description: GRAMA-documented staffing, rooftop, coordination, and emergency-alert failures at the Kirk event.
why_interesting: GRAMA records show roughly 6 campus officers for ~3,000 attendees, no ambulance on site, a false "suspect in custody" alert 19 minutes after the shot, and an alert still reading "Shooter in [INSERT location]" 88 minutes later.

title: UVU Courtyard
description: The courtyard where 3,000 people gathered, its sight lines, its four-channel audio record, and the people on its edge.
why_interesting: A Canon XA55 broadcast camera 46 meters out recorded four uncompressed audio channels; the analysis reports three distinct low-frequency booms — not one shot — with a Mach cone at ~+114 ms and muzzle blast at ~+202 ms.

title: UVU Campus Maps
description: Campus geometry, the affidavit's alleged suspect route, and the map landmarks every shooter-location theory is tested against.
why_interesting: The charging documents place the rooftop 150 yards from the stage, yet a ballistics note argues a shot at a crouching target from that height carries only a 5–9 degree downward angle — inconsistent with the observed neck wound.

title: UVU Administration Response
description: Cabinet-level actions, GRAMA-recorded pre-event decisions, alert failures, and post-shooting messaging by UVU leadership.
why_interesting: UVU acknowledged additional GRAMA records beyond the 112 released pages but withheld them, and offered no public engineering or preservation rationale for paving the courtyard four days after the homicide.

title: UVU Institutional Response
description: Institution-wide synthesis of UVU's pre-event planning, day-of alerts, records withholding, and post-shooting site changes.
why_interesting: The UVU-funded Joint Public Order Unit with Orem PD was never activated despite Orem PD emailing a ticket link on September 3, and no outside law enforcement was on scene during the event.

title: UVU Student Reactions
description: Student-facing effects: lockdown, false alerts, counseling, vigil, and student-captured eyewitness media.
why_interesting: UVU's official posts put the shooting at ~12:10 PM while prosecutor and FBI timelines use 12:23 PM — a 13-minute discrepancy, and about 10,000 students may have believed the threat was contained during the false-custody window.

title: UVU Social Media and Public Statements
description: Compiled claims from UVU's official X posts and public statements following the assassination.
why_interesting: Witness Ryne Simmons reportedly filmed the killing in 4K/60fps, sent it to the FBI, and says he was instructed to delete his copy — he says he kept one anyway.

title: UVU Faculty Statements
description: What records document about faculty exposure on September 10 — training gaps, lockdown conditions, and traceable statements.
why_interesting: GRAMA compilations report UVU faculty had received no active-shooter protocol training before hosting the event, and no public proof exists of any pre-event rooftop clearance by campus police.

title: UVU Investigation Index
description: Question-by-question map of every UVU thread plus a presence-only roster of people on campus September 10.
why_interesting: It frames UVU as both kill zone and institution, and rosters the AV and production crew feet from Kirk.

title: UVU
description: Landing page for the UVU section with a likelihood timeline for the moment of the shot and links to every subpage.
why_interesting: Its likelihood chart is explicitly not a government finding — it models the shot at about 12:23 PM MDT from public claims rather than from any official determination.

title: Erase It, You'll Get PTSD — The Clearest Copy Of That Account
description: A 1:15 testimonial in which a witness says an FBI contact advised him to delete his shooting footage.
why_interesting: A witness says a national-level FBI contact reportedly told him to erase his phone footage of the shooting to avoid PTSD, then called back to confirm he had deleted it.

title: Four Procurement Anomalies in the AES Contract
description: Walkthrough of a federal spending record for a miniaturized anti-personnel charge award, listing four procurement anomalies.
why_interesting: A USASpending record reportedly shows a $440,494 award for a miniaturized anti-personnel charge, with four flagged procurement anomalies — cited as support for the exploding-microphone thesis.

title: Police Radio: We've Been Given Clear Direction Not to Interview
description: 48 seconds of police radio traffic in which units say they were told not to interview witnesses.
why_interesting: On the day's radio traffic, officers state they were given clear direction by SBI and FBI not to interview, and to hold a man until federal agents arrived.

title: Zeb Boykin — A Scout Sniper's Frame-by-Frame Ballistics Read
description: A 22-minute four-angle ballistics breakdown by a former USMC Scout Sniper of the neck wound.
why_interesting: A former USMC Scout Sniper argues frame by frame that the neck wound is an exit, not an entrance, and that the shot came from Kirk's right — not the rooftop direction.

title: Court TV Clip: Officer Bagley on Why the Body Cam Ends on the Roof
description: Courtroom cross-examination about a body camera that stopped recording while the officer was on the roof.
why_interesting: In court an officer testifies his body camera battery died while he was still on the Losee Center roof, before the crime tape went up — so the rooftop is unrecorded.

title: There Was None — The Body-Camera Answer On the Record
description: Appeal-hearing audio in which a county representative says no body camera footage was located.
why_interesting: On the record at a records appeal, a county representative states a search for body camera footage of the surrender turned up none at all.

title: Joe Kent on Why the NCTC Foreign Review Stopped Early
description: Podcast clip in which a former NCTC director describes the foreign-ties review being halted.
why_interesting: Former NCTC director Joe Kent says the parallel review of foreign ties to the Kirk assassination was stopped once a suspect was in custody — before it could finish.

title: The Witness Lineup — Chest on FOX 13, Neck on KSL
description: Two same-day broadcast interviews in which the same witness describes different wound locations.
why_interesting: The same eyewitness describes a chest and heart wound to FOX 13, then a lower-neck wound to KSL about an hour later — the wound location shifts within a single afternoon.

title: Candace Owens Frame-by-Frame on the Tent Footage
description: Candace Owens walks the tent footage frame by frame and rejects the rifle-round account.
why_interesting: Candace Owens says she does not accept a .30-06 killed Charlie Kirk, citing the clean white shirt, the absence of backward blood spatter, and the necklace movement.

title: Project Constitution — Black Shards Falling From Charlie Kirk's Shirt
description: A 38-second slow-motion analysis circling dark fragments said to fall from under the shirt.
why_interesting: Slow-motion of the collapse reportedly shows small black shards dropping from beneath the shirt — debris consistent with a device on the body rather than an incoming rifle round.

title: The Pager-Attack Case, Compressed Into 113 Seconds
description: A captioned edit laying out the exploding-microphone thesis from motive to slow-motion neck analysis.
why_interesting: The edit sets the Lebanon exploding-pager operation beside RØDE lavalier clasp dimensions and ballistic-gel comparison, arguing the same miniature-charge method was used on stage.

title: The Full HADES Walkthrough: Both Passes, Tower Requests, Altitudes
description: Narrated breakdown of two low passes by surveillance aircraft N1098L over the area on September 10.
why_interesting: Surveillance aircraft N1098L reportedly made two low passes near UVU that day — 118 knots at a stated 600 feet, with a second pass at 12:48 Mountain, minutes after the shooting.

title: The 20-Minute Israeli-IP Walkthrough: Hospital, Examiner, Surgeons, Plane
description: Screen-share walkthrough of Google Trends clusters and flight data tied to the case.
why_interesting: The presenter shows search-trend clusters for the receiving hospital, its medical examiner and its surgeons said to originate from Israel-side IPs before the shooting.

title: Dan Merrell on the Call to Pave the Courtyard
description: The paving contractor describes who called him and the deadline he was given for the UVU courtyard.
why_interesting: The contractor who laid the UVU pavers describes being called with a Monday deadline to redo the courtyard — the crime scene surface was replaced within days.

title: Candace Owens on the Provo Drop-Off Claim
description: Candace Owens relays a source claim about foreign military subcontractors arriving in Provo.
why_interesting: Candace Owens says a source told her Egyptian military subcontractors were dropped in Provo and did not leave on the aircraft that returned — an allegation she attributes to that source.

title: Court Testimony on the Cellebrite Extraction of Twiggs's Phone
description: Courtroom testimony establishing a forensic phone extraction and the first message recovered.
why_interesting: Court testimony confirms a Cellebrite extraction of Lance Twiggs's phone, putting the Discord-message evidence chain into the record for the first time.

title: Baron Coleman on the 6:25 PM Bates Document
description: Document walkthrough of a defence filing and booking sheet on when the suspect was read his rights.
why_interesting: Attorney Baron Coleman argues from a Bates-stamped filing that the Miranda time of 6:25 PM does not fit the publicly stated custody sequence.

title: Baron Coleman: A Multi-Agency Cover-Up and the Custody Clock
description: Attorney states his view that the published custody timeline does not add up.
why_interesting: Attorney Baron Coleman says on camera that he believes the Robinson custody timeline reflects a multi-agency cover-up, not an ordinary arrest sequence.

title: Surveillance Cut Stamped 12:23:35 PM (roofshooter3)
description: A campus security composite carrying a legible burned-in timestamp seconds after the shot.
why_interesting: This retrieval of the campus surveillance composite carries a burned-in stamp reading 9/10/2025 12:23:35 PM, pinning the roof-figure sequence to seconds after the report.

title: Joshua Peterson's Self-Recorded Whistleblower Statement
description: A former TPUSA representative alleges he was questioned about Israel during a training outing.
why_interesting: A named former TPUSA representative alleges on camera that he was probed about his views on Israel during a staff training outing — a single uncorroborated account.

title: Candace Owens: The Source of the They Are Going to Kill Me Claim
description: Podcast interview in which Owens says a staffer holds a text from Kirk sent the day before his death.
why_interesting: Candace Owens states an unnamed TPUSA staffer holds a text Charlie Kirk allegedly sent the day before he died; no screenshot has been released to support it.

title: Tucker Carlson: Most Likely Murdered For His Evolving Views on Israel
description: A short audio clip of Tucker Carlson giving his own read on the motive.
why_interesting: Tucker Carlson says on tape he believes Charlie Kirk was most likely murdered over his shifting position on Israel — a mainstream host naming a foreign-policy motive.

title: Benny Johnson: Considerable Evidence That There Were State Actors
description: A 51-second broadcast capture of a commentator alleging state-actor involvement.
why_interesting: Benny Johnson says he believes there is considerable evidence state actors were involved, then stops with I can't go any further than that — naming no country.

title: Rob O'Neill and Brig. Gen. Blaine Holt on the Official Account
description: A former SEAL Team Six operator and a retired Air Force general question the official narrative.
why_interesting: A SEAL Team Six veteran and a retired brigadier general say on camera the official account does not match their operational experience and ask for an ordinary murder investigation.

title: All Of These Results Were Gone: A Claim About Vanished Searches
description: A host says open-source search results shown on air the previous night no longer returned anything.
why_interesting: Stew Peters says he tried to reproduce a guest's open-source search results live on air and found the records had stopped returning results overnight.

title: The Jail-Call Interview - Zinn's Own Account
description: A recorded jail call in which George Zinn gives his account of the day and prior TPUSA work.
why_interesting: In a recorded jail call the man who shouted a confession at the scene describes prior door-knocking work for TPUSA and denies being paid to cause a scene.

title: Shoot Me - The Tunnel Detention, Annotated
description: Annotated clip of the underpass detention capturing a man shouting a confession.
why_interesting: Scene audio captures a man shouting shoot me, kill me as he is detained in the underpass — an instant false confession minutes after the shot, while bystanders doubt it is him.

title: Fifteen Minutes Inside The Police Scanner Traffic
description: A breakdown of the day's Utah police radio traffic and its shifting suspect descriptions.
why_interesting: Scanner traffic reportedly carries a hospital report the hospital later denied, shifting suspect-vehicle descriptions, and a licence plate that returned nothing.

title: Project Constitution — Checking Sightlines From the Corner
description: A pan of the plaza testing whether the corner crowds turned toward has line of sight to the tent.
why_interesting: The segment argues the corner where crowd reactions converged has no line of sight to the tent at all — so the direction people instinctively turned cannot be the shot origin.

title: Eleven Recordings, Seven Defensible: The Spectrogram Breakdown
description: Acoustic comparison of a professional camcorder track against phone captures of the report.
why_interesting: Of eleven recordings of the sound, only seven survive as acoustically defensible, and the low-frequency band is compared across a Canon XA55 and iPhone captures.

title: Ballistic Gel Head Shot — High-Speed Test Clip
description: A high-speed ballistics test of a rifle round striking a gelatin head-and-shoulders bust.
why_interesting: The test shows what a rifle round actually does to a head-and-neck target in slow motion — circulated because the stage footage shows nothing comparable happening.

title: Kirk on Epstein: He Was Playing a Part
description: A Charlie Kirk Show segment in which Kirk argues Epstein was a role in a blackmail operation.
why_interesting: Kirk says on his own show that Jeffrey Epstein was not a financier but played a part in a long-running blackmail operation, and names intelligence services as possible sponsors.

title: The Alibi Clip and the Carpet Comparison
description: Silent office CCTV timestamped the day before, reposted with a claim about the interior's location.
why_interesting: Fourteen seconds of CCTV stamped 09:17 on September 9, 2025 is reposted with a claim the interior finishes match Fort Huachuca — recorded as a claim, not adopted.

title: Project Constitution - The Utah State Intelligence Centre Question
description: A short piece on a university intelligence centre and the accused's single semester there.
why_interesting: Utah State hosts a Center for Anticipatory Intelligence founded by former agency personnel — and Tyler Robinson spent one semester at USU in 2021.

title: A Home Demonstration Of A 2.5 Gram Shaped Charge Against A Padlock
description: A silent demonstration assembling and detonating a miniature copper-cone shaped charge.
why_interesting: A 2.5 gram copper-cone shaped charge — small enough to hide in a microphone clasp — is built and detonated on camera to show what that quantity of explosive can do.

title: Four Photographs of the SUV Interior, Circled in Red
description: A short slideshow of SUV interior photographs showing debris, fragments and staining.
why_interesting: Photographs of the vehicle interior are circulated with the claim that the fragments visible inside resemble device debris rather than anything a rifle round would leave.

title: Wolves and Finance on the TPUSA Entity Structure
description: A financial commentator breaks down TPUSA's affiliated entities and money flows.
why_interesting: An accountant walks the filings for TPUSA's network of affiliated entities, showing how money moves between the nonprofit, the action arm and related organizations.

title: Drone Shot From the TPUSA Birthday Tribute Video
description: A silent aerial shot of the packed plaza taken from TPUSA's own tribute video.
why_interesting: TPUSA's own October tribute video contains an aerial shot of the packed September 10 plaza — circulated as evidence a drone was flying, contrary to reports of none.

title: Vote
description: Covers how citizens can use voting and civic pressure to force disclosure and accountability in the Charlie Kirk case.
why_interesting: Points out the autopsy and medical-examiner records remain sealed and FBI/intelligence files withheld, and urges voters to track which lawmakers vote against forced-disclosure bills.

title: "You Just See It Hit His Chest" — Second-Row Witnesses Describe a Heart Shot
description: Second-row witnesses on camera describe the impact landing on Kirk's chest and blood coming from the middle of his chest.
why_interesting: Two second-row witnesses say on camera "you just see it hit his chest" and "shot in the heart" — directly conflicting with the state's neck-wound .30-06 account, never publicly reconciled.

title: Shot in the Chest, Then the Neck — One Witness, Two Accounts
description: One witness's televised wound description shifts from chest and heart to neck between two stations about an hour apart.
why_interesting: The same witness reportedly said "directly into his heart" three times, then told a different station under an hour later it was "in the neck, lower neck" — with the clip preserved.

title: Shot to the Heart — The Repeated Theme and the Shaped-Charge Question
description: Collects the recurring early "direct shot to the heart" witness theme and the shaped-charge alternative some researchers propose.
why_interesting: Angie Martin, a retired 20-year Unified Police officer, says on camera the wound pattern suggests a shot from below, and researchers argue a shaped charge fired at an angle explains it.

title: Wrong Witnesses — Why the Same Wrong Detail?
description: Asks why several on-camera witnesses gave the same chest or heart wound detail that commentators say the footage does not show.
why_interesting: Multiple unconnected witnesses used near-identical heart-wound wording; the page asks whether a shaped charge in the lapel microphone was designed to produce exactly that chest wound.

title: Nick — UVU Witness
description: On-camera street interview with a UVU witness describing the sound, the crowd reaction, and the shot direction.
why_interesting: Nick says a group at the top of the venue cheered when Kirk was hit, and describes only a "loud pop" — not the heavy crack of a .30-06 — with the shot entering from Kirk's right.

title: EksAyn Anderson — Front-Row Question
description: Records a question raised on X about a self-described behavioural expert reportedly seated in UVU's reserved front row.
why_interesting: An X account asks why a self-described "human behavioural expert" tied to BYU was reportedly in the reserved front row; four photos are preserved, and no wrongdoing is alleged.

title: Witnesses
description: Index of firsthand UVU witness accounts, with a featured clip and a caution about interviews versus sworn testimony.
why_interesting: Notes that none of these widely cited on-camera accounts are sworn testimony, and features the clip where one witness's chest account becomes a neck account within an hour.

title: Your Actions Fix It
description: Practical guide to lawful citizen action: FOIA/GRAMA filings, the four Fix Laws, IPFS video preservation, and pressure on legislators.
why_interesting: Notes that former NCTC director Joe Kent has said on the record his center's parallel review of potential foreign ties was ordered stopped before its leads were exhausted.
